jobs.title: Financial Master Data Analyst
jobs.description:
Upjohn Export B.V. sucursal Costa Rica 
 Viatris is a global healthcare company uniquely positioned to bridge the traditional divide between generics and brands, combining the best of both to more holistically address healthcare needs globally. With a mission to empower people worldwide to live healthier at every stage of life, we provide access at scale, currently supplying high-quality medicines to approximately 1 billion patients around the world annually and touching all of life s moments, from birth to the end of life, acute conditions to chronic diseases. 
 
 We have been included on number of award lists that demonstrate the impact we are making.  
 Every day, we rise to the challenge of making a difference and here’s how the Financial Master Data Analyst role will make an impact:
  
 The Financial Master Data (FMD) Analyst will create and maintain financial master data in necessary systems and in accordance with company policies, procedures, master data processes, and master data governance model. The Analyst will also support maintaining policy-aligned approval tables within systems needing to consume such data. Decision-making and solving problems of in-depth scope and complexity required to achieve quality execution and adherence to master data process and governance. This position will also support the reviewing, improving, and identifying of opportunities for innovation and within the established master data maintenance processes. The responsibilities of this role incorporate a variety of functions concurrently for maintenance of the master data that is essential to the company financial statements.
 Additionally, this position will be also supporting the different project implementations where the FMD support is needed. coordinating efforts with stakeholders related with the creation and maintenance of the Finance Master Data and the mapping maintenance.
  
 Key responsibilities for this role include: 
 Create and maintain financial master data to support business processes (including but not limited to: approval flow mapping, Chart of Accounts for GL Accounts and Cost Elements, Cost Centers and Cost Center standard hierarchy, Profit Centers and Profit Center standard hierarchy, bank keys, foreign exchange rates, and financial statement versions) in accordance with company policy, including approver maintenance for Viatris’ Global E-Procurement tool, Legal Contracts Management tool, and invoice approval routing / reconciliation tool.
 Support collection of master data, related financial reporting mapping and all related approval mapping to support a variety of systems requirements.
 Ensure Financial master data is evaluated and created in such a way that processes will function efficiently, effectively and in accordance with company policy.
 Manage requests from users for new master data and changes to existing master data.
 Track assigned financial master data requests from users and prioritize requests according to set guidelines and Service Level Agreements (SLAs).
 Maintain and update associated training material, process documentation and forms related to collection and maintenance of financial master data.
 Implement and maintain effective communications with key internal and external partners.
 Maintain effective communications with core FMD virtual team.
 Provide master data guidance and training when appropriate.
 Solve issues / scenarios and perform data and risk analysis of varying complexity (low, medium and high) following established policies and procedures in order to reach a logical conclusion/solution to a request.
 Support and participate in master data maintenance activities related to system implementations, upgrades, enhancements, integrations, legal entity consolidations and other various business driven projects.
 Support and ensure adherence to defined Service Level Agreements (SLAs).
 Collaborate with core FMD virtual team in efforts outside of normal business as usual tasks; namely: integration, enhancements and business directives.
 Identify process improvement opportunities.
 Support ERP project implementations, coordinate effort with stakeholders and business in order support these projects from the FMD perspective.
 Support Approval & Authorizations (CFA) activities and process related.
 Perform other duties as assigned according to the FMD operational process requirements.
  
 The minimum qualifications for this role are: 
   Knowledge 
 Awareness of systems and requirements relating to master data processing – forms, approvals, and policy.
 Knowledge of chart of accounts and maintenance – account types, normal balances, where and how used.
 Knowledge of Hyperion or other financial reporting tools and their master data maintenance activities.
 Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite -- particularly Excel and Outlook -- and related tools.
 Awareness of internal controls and mitigations (SOX Compliance).
 Awareness of U.S. Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (USGAAP).
 Experience in the following business areas preferred: Finance, Accounting or Financial Planning & Analysis. However, a combination of experience and/or education will be taken into consideration.
 SAP experience preferred.
 Skills And Abilities 
 Ability to understand multi-dimensional approval matrices and translate to system approval rules.
 Ability to interpret and analyze customer requests and make master data recommendations to achieve accurate and policy-aligned execution.
 Ability to see the macro and micro view of requests and determine best course for implementation.
 Ability to work independently and as a team member.
 Ability to communication and interact clearly, effectively, and professionally in English with core FMD virtual team and a diverse group of global users verbally and in written form.
 Ability to collect data and perform data and risk analysis to reach a logical conclusion/solution to a request.
 Ability to quickly identify and resolve issues related to finance master data.
 Ability to rank and prioritize work for timely delivery.
 Ability to meet individual and department deadlines with minimal supervision.
 Ability to plan, organize and execute master data maintenance in accordance with established procedures.
 Ability to create and manage related process documentation.
 Possess strong organizational skills for managing requests from across the globe.
 Education/Experience 
 Minimum of a Bachelor s degree or the equivalent in experience (2 – 4 years of experience).
 Experience in finance related industry for 2 - 4 years. 
 Experience in data analytics and auditing preferred.
 Language Skills 
 English B2 minimum, Portuguese is a plus.
 Ability to read and interpret complex business and/or technical documents.
 Ability to write business correspondence in English.
 Ability to work with groups of people such as other departments and communicate known concepts.
 Ability to present to a group.
 Reasoning Ability 
 Ability to apply logic and quantitative reasoning. 
 Ability to draw inferences and follow prescribed and detailed procedures to all scenarios.
 
 A t Viatris, we offer   competitive   salar ies , benefits   and   an inclusive environment where you can use your experiences, perspectives and skills to help make an impact on the lives of others.   
 
 Viatris is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: EHS&S Digital Solution Specialist
jobs.description:
At Dow, we believe in putting people first and we’re passionate about delivering integrity, respect and safety to our customers, our employees and the planet.    
   
 Our people are at the heart of our solutions. They reflect the communities we live in and the world where we do business. Their diversity is our strength. We’re a community of relentless problem solvers that offers the daily opportunity to contribute with your perspective, transform industries and shape the future. Our purpose is simple - to deliver a sustainable future for the world through science and collaboration.   If you’re looking for a challenge and meaningful role, you’re in the right place.   
 
 
 About you and this role   
  
 Dow has an exciting and challenging opportunity for Digital Solution Specialist , based in Navi Mumbai (India) to join the Environment, Health, Safety and Sustainability (EHS&S) Information Technology team. In this role, you will own and manage a small EHS&S portfolio of digital solutions and systems, guiding them through their full lifecycle—analysis, design, implementation, adoption, optimization, and end-of-life retirement. Your work will deliver advanced EHS&S functional and business capabilities that accelerate Dow’s digital transformation. 
 You will collaborate with a multi-disciplinary IT team—including analysts, designers, developers, and support specialists—to deliver innovative, user-centric solutions. A key part of your role is to gather and analyze data to define functional and technical requirements, with a strong focus on experience, simplification, automation, efficiency, and reliability. You will also oversee development and adoption of solutions leveraging best-in-class mobile, web, desktop, and cloud technologies, while identifying opportunities for digital innovation. 
  
 Responsibilities  
 Requirements Analysis: Understand key business drivers to explore, analyze, and map business and functional requirements.  
 Experience Mapping: Translate user journeys and stories into solutions that enhance employee and customer experience (EX/CX).  
 Solution Lifecycle Management: Drive end-to-end lifecycle—design, architecture, integration (buy vs. build), development, testing, and compliance with corporate standards and security policies.  
 Adoption & Support: Support implementation, user adoption, and define supplier/team support models.  
 Performance Management: Establish controls, KPIs, and measures for solution performance and reliability.  
 Integration & Optimization: Coordinate with Solution Managers and Business Process Managers for end-to-end process integration.  
 Roadmap Development: Define improvement and innovation roadmaps; assess resources, technology, and investment needs.  
 Team Support: Assist senior Solution Managers with workload analysis and capacity planning.  
 Ability to analyze and resolve problems using technical expertise and sound judgment. Strong communication skills to explain complex concepts and provide informal guidance to new team members.  
 Qualifications  
 Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, EHS&S, or a related field.  
 Min 5 years of work experience in the role. 
 Knowledge and experience with EHS and Sustainability processes and technologies.   
 Experience supporting sustainability, decarbonization, carbon accounting, environmental compliance, product carbon footprint (PCF), or lifecycle assessment (LCA) initiatives through digital solutions and data-driven capabilities .  
 Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.   
 Knowledge of AI, Generative AI, Microsoft Copilot, and automation technologies. 
 Strong understanding of system integration and application architecture, including API integrations, data flow analysis, end-to-end process integration, and Azure Integration Services. 
 Experience working with Databricks, SQL, and Azure DevOps. 
 Proficiency in Microsoft Power Platform (Power Apps, Power BI, Power Automate) and Copilot solutions. 
 Knowledge of software development concepts and modern application delivery practices. 
 Experience working in Agile/Scrum delivery environments. 
 Understanding of cloud-based technologies, enterprise data management, and digital transformation initiatives. 
  
 Your Skills  
 Business Requirements: The ability to gather, analyze, and translate business needs into clear functional and technical requirements that guide the design and delivery of effective digital solutions. 
 Solutions Delivery: Managing the full lifecycle of digital solutions—including design, integration, development, testing, deployment, optimization, and retirement—to ensure they meet performance, security, and usability expectations. 
 Design Thinking: Applying user‑centered methods such as journey mapping and experience analysis to create solutions that improve employee and customer experience while driving simplification, automation, and efficiency. 
 Integration Services: Coordinating and defining end‑to‑end system and process integrations to ensure seamless data flow and interoperability across applications, platforms, and business processes. 
 Strategic Planning: Developing solution roadmaps, identifying digital innovation opportunities, and aligning technology investments and resource needs with organizational strategy and long‑term business goals environment. 
 
 Additional notes 
 The ability to accommodate a flexible schedule aligned with international time zones is essential. 
 Relocation assistance is not provided with this position. 
 
 
 
 
 Benefits – What Dow offers you  
 
 We invest in you.   
 Dow invests in total rewards programs to help you manage all aspects of you: your pay, your health, your life, your future, and your career. You bring your background, talent, and perspective to work every day. Dow rewards that commitment by investing in your total wellbeing.   
 Here are just a few highlights of what you would be offered as a Dow employee: 
 Equitable and market-competitive base pay and bonus opportunity across our global markets, along with locally relevant incentives. 
 Benefits and programs to support your physical, mental, financial, and social well-being, to help you get the care you need...when you need it. 
 Competitive retirement program that may include company-provided benefits, savings opportunities, financial planning, and educational resources to help you achieve your long term financial-goals.  Employee stock purchase programs (availability varies depending on location).
 
 Student Debt Retirement Savings Match Program (U.S. only). Dow will take the value of monthly student debt payments and apply them as if they are contributions to the Employees’ Savings Plan (401(k)), helping employees reach the Company match.
 
 Robust medical and life insurance packages that offer a variety of coverage options to meet your individual needs. Travel insurance is also available in certain countries/locations.
 Opportunities to learn and grow through training and mentoring, work experiences, community involvement and team building. 
 Workplace culture empowering role-based flexibility to maximize personal productivity and balance personal needs. 
 Competitive yearly vacation allowance.
 Paid time off for new parents (birthing and non-birthing, including adoptive and foster parents).   
 Paid time off to care for family members who are sick or injured.  
 Paid time off to support volunteering and Employee Resource Group’s (ERG) participation. 
 Wellbeing Portal for all Dow employees, our one-stop shop to promote wellbeing, empowering employees to take ownership of their entire wellbeing journey.
 On-site fitness facilities to help stay healthy and active (availability varies depending on location).
 Employee discounts for online shopping, cinema tickets, gym memberships and more.
 Additionally, some of our locations might offer: Transportation allowance (availability varies depending on location)
 Meal subsidiaries/vouchers (availability varies depending on location)
 Carbon-neutral transportation incentives e.g. bike to work (availability varies depending on location)
 
 
 Join our team, we can make a difference together.
 
 About Dow Chemical International Pvt Ltd 
 Dow Chemical International Private Limited (Dow India) aims to be the most innovative, sustainable, inclusive customer-centric materials science company. The company is committed to delivering the right solutions to its customers’ challenges. With broadest technology sets spanning performance materials, industrial intermediates, and plastics Dow India delivers differentiated science-based products and solutions in high-growth segments, such as packaging, infrastructure, automobile, and consumer care.
 
 A Great Place to Work® Certified company with approximately over 1000 employees, its operations comprise of manufacturing sites, innovation center, established centers of excellence, and commercial office. As a responsible corporate, the company supports its Corporate Social Responsibility (program) with technology expertise and employee volunteerism. Dow India works with non-profit partners towards the empowerment of differently abled, women, and children in communities where it operates. The company aims to redefine the societal blueprint, by supporting holistic sustainability and circular economy initiatives.
 
 
 As part of our dedication to inclusion, Dow is committed to equal opportunities in employment .  We encourage every employee to bring their whole self to work each day to not only deliver more value, but also have a more fulfilling career. Further information regarding Dow s equal opportunities is available on www.dow.com .

jobs.title: Data Analyst
jobs.description:
At Ecolab, you can help take on some of the world’s most meaningful challenges, delivering critical insights and innovative solutions to help our customers achieve clean water, safe food, abundant energy and healthy environments. With our worldwide reach and ambitious growth plans, you will have the opportunity to own your future and impact what matters. Are you ready to make an impact?
 
 Ecolab is searching for a driven Data Analyst for our Enterprise Growth Operations Team in Pune, India .
 
 The Data Analyst is a key member of Ecolab’s Enterprise Growth Operations team, supporting global enterprise accounts through data-driven insights and analytical support. In this role, you will be the data scientist for the business—helping turn complex data into actionable insights that improve visibility into sales performance, pipeline health, and execution effectiveness. By partnering closely with global stakeholders, the Data Analyst helps identify opportunities to accelerate sales velocity, improve decision-making, and drive measurable business impact across the enterprise. 
 
 What’s in it For You: 
 You will join a growth company offering a competitive salary and benefits. 
 The ability to make an impact and shape your career with a company that is passionate about growth.
 The support of an organization that believes it is vital to include and engage diverse people, perspectives and ideas to achieve our best.
 Feel proud each day to work for a company that provides clean water, safe food, abundant energy and healthy environments.
 
 What You Will Do: 
 Support the Enterprise Growth Enablement and Enterprise Solutions teams by delivering analytics and insights that directly improve Sales Velocity:
 Increase qualified opportunities
 Enable larger deal value
 Improve win rates
 Reduce sales cycle time
 Analyze sales pipeline, deal progression, win/loss performance, and cycle times to identify trends, patterns, and potential drivers of business performance
 Develop and maintain standard and ad hoc reporting related to pipeline health, deal size, conversion rates, and time-in-stage metrics
 Partner with the Growth Enablement Manager and Enterprise Solutions account teams to be the data scientist translating business needs into helpful analytics and insights to influence business decisions
 Assist in tracking and reporting key growth metrics such as pipeline value, Total Value Delivered (TVD), and revenue impact
 Document business use cases, data definitions, and reporting logic to ensure repeatability and governance
 Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives by identifying process inefficiencies and recommending data-driven improvements
 Validate analytical outputs to ensure accuracy, consistency, and usability of insights

jobs.title: Sr Associate Data Analytics & Reporting
jobs.description:
Career Category 
Supply Chain 
 Job Description 
 ABOUT AMGEN 
 Amgen harnesses the best of biology and technology to fight the world’s toughest diseases, and make people’s lives easier, fuller and longer. We discover, develop, manufacture and deliver innovative medicines to help millions of patients. Amgen helped establish the biotechnology industry more than 40 years ago and remains on the cutting-edge of innovation, using technology and human genetic data to push beyond what’s known today.
 ABOUT THE ROLE 
 The Engineering Data Analysis & Reporting Analyst is an individual contributor role responsible for delivering trusted, standardized analytics, reporting, and insights across Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) and Engineering Operations Services (EOS) domains.
 This role enables data-driven decision-making by designing, developing, and maintaining dashboards, KPI frameworks, and analytics solutions that provide actionable insights into operational performance, compliance, risk management, and continuous improvement initiatives.
 Reporting to the Engineering Data analysis and Reporting Lead, this role partners closely with Engineering, EHS, EOS, Master Data Management, Data Engineering, and Technology teams to ensure reporting solutions are scalable, secure, compliant, and aligned with enterprise data and analytics strategies. The role will leverage Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, Enterprise Data Lake (EDL), Power BI, and Tableau platforms to integrate data, build reporting solutions, and maintain KPI governance standards.
 ROLES & RESPONSIBILITIES 
 Develop, maintain, and enhance standardized dashboards, scorecards, and reports supporting EHS and EOS governance, operational performance, compliance monitoring, and business decision-making.
 Design and implement interactive reporting solutions using Power BI, Tableau, and Microsoft Fabric to provide actionable business insights.
 Integrate and transform data from Enterprise Data Lake (EDL), Databricks, enterprise applications, and other data sources to create scalable reporting and analytics solutions.
 Build and maintain datasets, semantic models, and reporting layers that ensure consistent KPI calculations and reporting standards across EHS and EOS.
 Establish, maintain, and continuously improve the EHS and EOS KPI Registry, including KPI definitions, business rules, calculations, ownership, targets, thresholds, source systems, and reporting governance.
 Define, document, and maintain leading and lagging indicators that support proactive risk management, operational performance monitoring, and compliance reporting.
 Support the Data Analysis and Reporting Lead in managing and maintaining SharePoint sites, reporting content, document libraries, permissions, and data resources; requires proficiency in SharePoint administration, information architecture, data organization, access management, and stakeholder support. 
 Ensure analytics and reporting solutions are accurate, traceable, validated, and audit ready.
 Perform data validation, reconciliation, and quality checks to ensure data integrity and reporting reliability.
 Translate business, operational, compliance, and stakeholder requirements into reporting and analytics solutions.
 Analyze data to identify trends, performance gaps, risks, opportunities, and emerging signals that support continuous improvement initiatives.
 Develop executive-level reporting, management scorecards, and ad-hoc analytics to support strategic and operational decision-making.
 Collaborate with Systems, Master Data Management, Data Engineering, and Technology teams to improve data quality, governance, and reporting capabilities.
 Support reporting governance processes, KPI standardization, metric alignment, and reporting best practices.
 Identify opportunities to automate reporting processes, streamline workflows, and improve reporting efficiency through analytics and technology solutions.
 Create and maintain reporting documentation, data dictionaries, KPI definitions, and process documentation to support sustainable operations and knowledge management.
 Engage stakeholders across Engineering, EHS, EOS, Operations, Quality, Compliance, and Technology organizations to ensure reporting solutions meet business needs and drive adoption.
 Interpret data using sound analytical methods and business context to provide meaningful recommendations and actionable insights.
 BASIC QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE  
 Bachelor’s degree in Data Analytics, Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Statistics, Business Analytics, or related fields.
 5–9 years of experience in business intelligence, analytics, reporting, data visualization, or data management roles.
 Hands-on experience developing dashboards and reporting solutions using Power BI and Tableau.
 Experience developing KPI frameworks, metric definitions, reporting standards, and governance processes.
 Experience integrating and analyzing data from multiple enterprise systems and data sources.
 Demonstrated experience translating business requirements into reporting and analytics solutions.
 Experience performing data validation, quality assurance, and reporting controls within a regulated environment.
 Ability to work on site in Hyderabad and collaborate with stakeholders across global time zones when required.
 PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS & SKILLS 
 Advanced expertise with Power BI, Tableau, Microsoft Fabric, and Databricks analytics environments.
 Experience building and maintaining KPI registries, metric catalogs, data dictionaries, and reporting governance frameworks.
 Strong understanding of leading and lagging indicators, operational performance metrics, and risk-based reporting methodologies.
 Experience supporting EHS, Engineering, Facilities, Manufacturing, Operations, or Quality business functions.
 Experience working with EHS platforms such as Cority, Sphera, Enablon, or similar systems.
 Knowledge of enterprise data governance, master data management, and data quality best practices.
 Strong stakeholder management and collaboration skills with the ability to influence without direct authority.
 Excellent verbal, written, and presentation communication skills.
 Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver results in a fast-paced global environment.
 Experience supporting continuous improvement, automation, and digital transformation initiatives.
 Familiarity with AI-enabled analytics, predictive reporting, and advanced visualization techniques.
 Experience working across regions and time zones with global stakeholder teams.
 
 PROFESSIONAL CERTIFICATIONS: 
 Certifications in Microsoft Power BI , Tableau (Certified Professional) , or Databricks (Data Analyst/Data Engineer) are advantageous and considered a plus.

 We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided with reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.
 
 Work Hours 
 Work hours and shift requirements may vary based on business needs. Flexibility to work across different shifts may be required.

jobs.title: Senior Analyst - Forecasting
jobs.description:
GCL : D1 
 Introduction to role: 
 Are you ready to turn complex data into clear, confident decisions that shape the future of life-changing medicines? In this role, you will develop patient, volume, and revenue forecasts for strategic brands and early assets across Global priority markets and the US—work that directly informs brand strategy, investment decisions, and how we reach patients faster!
 Based at Manyata Tech Park, Bangalore on a hybrid schedule (three days a week in office) with a 2 PM - 11 PM IST shift, you will partner closely with forecasting leadership and Commercial teams. You will build and own models that set performance expectations, provide clarity on risk and opportunity, and guide cross-functional teams toward decisive action. Do you thrive in a dynamic environment where your analysis sparks strategy and your point of view earns trust? 
 Accountabilities: 
 Develop and own forecast models. Build, validate, and maintain strong short-term and long-term models. These models reflect current data, assumptions, and market dynamics for key brands and initial assets.
 Decision Support: Translate insights into clear recommendations, expertly defend methodologies and assumptions, and influence cross-functional collaborators with clear logic and quantified confidence.
 Cross-Functional Alignment: Align forecast assumptions and analytical outputs with partners in Marketing, Sales, Market Access and Pricing, Finance, Analytics, and Sales Operations to ensure a single, trusted view of demand.
 New Product Introduction: Develop volume forecasts for launches to feed strategic and operational planning, informing resourcing, supply, and market activation.
 Data and Methodology Difficulty: Identify and apply the right data sources and industry-leading approaches; integrate primary research and secondary data to ensure objectivity and comprehensive coverage.
 Sensitivity and Scenario Analysis: Conduct simulations and ranges (including Monte Carlo as appropriate) to clarify uncertainty, quantify upside/downside, and support risk management.
 Global Pipeline and Early Assets: Create new forecast frameworks as business needs emerge for pipeline assets, lifecycle management, and business development opportunities.
 US Planning Cadence: For US-focused work, participate in S&OP processes, submit volumes, and build weekly, monthly, and annual models and conversions aligned to commercial rhythms.
 Continuous Improvement: Evolve forecasting capabilities through innovation in methodologies, automation, and tools; champion standard processes that improve speed, reliability, and decision quality.
 Documentation and Communication: Deliver forecasts with clear, accessible documentation of assumptions, confidence levels, and key drivers; proactively surface issues that matter to the business. 
 Essential Skills/Experience: 
 Bachelor’s Degree in relevant field
 6 years of direct Pharmaceutical forecasting experience with an in-depth knowledge of forecasting techniques, models and approaches
 Good understanding of multiple disease areas, with experience in rare diseases/ OBU including how patients move through their respective diagnosis and treatment pathways, including treatment dynamics
 Experience integrating insights from market research and secondary data analysis into forecast assumptions
 Experience using a range of data sources and analytics involving standard data in the Pharmaceutical industry – e.g. IQVIA (MIDAS, DDD NPA, Monthly Xponent), claims data (Truven, Marketscan), epidemiological data, etc. For US forecasting, experience with TRx / NBRx / NRx data and methodologies
 Strong analytical expertise; excellent Excel, financial modelling and forecasting skills
 Ability to build trusted relationships across a range of partner groups including Marketing, Analytics, Operations, and Technology
 Confirmed experience in problem solving and continuous improvement
 Strong written and verbal communication 
 Desirable Skills/Experience: 
 Advanced degree or equivalent experience preferred (e.g., PhD, MBA, Masters)
 Knowledge and experience in sophisticated statistical forecast methodologies and applied AI / ML / automation
 Experience working with Power Apps, specifically PowerBI
 For US forecasting, confirmed understanding of US Market Access and gross-to-net

 Join a high-performing, digitally savvy community where bold thinking is encouraged and supported. Here,unexpected teams come together to ignite bold ideas, using advanced technology and data to accelerate decisions impacting patients. You will have the freedom to think differently, take balanced risks, and see your work drive tangible change across the enterprise. We value persistence alongside ambition, and you will grow your craft by learning from bright minds who challenge and support one another every day.

 Bring your forecasting expertise to where it makes a difference—apply today to build models that guide bold decisions and improve patient outcomes!

jobs.title: Sr. Analyst, US Customer Engagement Measurement & Insights
jobs.description:
At Bristol Myers Squibb, our employees often ask, “Who are you working for?”—a question that fuels collaboration, accountability, and urgency in our work. Our purpose-driven culture inspires us to discover, develop, and deliver innovative medicines to prevail over serious diseases. We offer uniquely interesting and meaningful work, opportunities for growth, and a supportive environment that values inclusion, wellbeing, flexibility, and comprehensive benefits. This is work that transforms the lives of patients, and the careers of those who do it.
 Roles & Responsibilities   
 Customer Engagement Measurement & Analytics Delivery   
 Independently delivered measurement analyses assessing the effectiveness of omnichannel customer engagement across field, CRM, paid media, owned digital, and third-party channels.  
 Apply machine learning techniques to identify patterns in customer engagement, channel synergy, sequencing, pacing, and message performance.  
 Support the development and operationalization of measurement frameworks, KPI tracking tools, and performance dashboards aligned with the team s strategic priorities.  
 Analyze HCP and patient journeys, funnels, channel sequencing, and frequency to identify drivers of engagement and opportunities to optimize campaigns.  
 Track and report channel-level and cross-channel campaign KPIs (e.g., reach, open and click rates, engagement depth, conversion, response, cost efficiency, and downstream impact on prescribing or patient behavior).  
 Synthesize analytical findings into clear, structured outputs and actionable recommendations for internal stakeholders and team leads.  
 Experimentation & Test-and-Learn Support   
 Support the design and execution of AI-informed test-and-learn strategies , including A/B tests, lift studies, and incrementality experiments across customer engagement tactics.  
 Assist in defining success metrics, measurement windows, and statistical approaches to evaluate new engagement strategies.  
 Contribute to the documentation and socialization of experimental learnings to inform ongoing campaign planning across brands.  
 Help refine experimentation frameworks to accelerate learning cycles and improve engagement effectiveness.  
 Advanced Analytics & Attribution   
 Apply advanced statistical and AI/ML techniques to measure the incremental impact of customer engagement activities.  
 Support the use of attribution frameworks such as multi-touch attribution, Markov chain modelling, and causal inference methods (e.g., propensity scoring, matched control).  
 Contribute to the integration of outputs from MMx, KDA, and predictive models to support engagement optimization strategies.  
 Leverage automation to improve speed, consistency, and repeatability of insights delivery.  
 Stakeholder Partnership & Communication   
 Partner with US Commercial stakeholders, Brand, Omnichannel Strategy, Field Analytics, CRM, Digital, Digital Marketing, Campaign Management, Martech/CRM Operations, Media Agency, Web Analytics, and Technology teams to contribute to campaign and channel measurement solution design.  
 Clearly communicate measurement methodologies, assumptions, model limitations, and implications for decision-making to both technical and non-technical audiences.  
 Contribute to stakeholder presentations and working sessions with structured, insight-driven storytelling focused on impact and commercial actions.  
 Team Collaboration & Capability Building   
 Collaborate within cross-functional and global teams to ensure consistent, scalable, and governed analytical delivery aligned with AI best practices.  
 Mentor junior analysts on advanced measurement methodologies, analytical rigor, and responsible data usage.  
 Contribute to the development of reusable analytics frameworks, measurement templates, and best practices that scale across brands.  
 Promote high standards of reproducibility and documentation across all team deliverables.  
 Technical Execution & Data Stewardship   
 Build and maintain campaign and channel AI-enabled measurement datasets, dashboards, and automated workflows supporting omnichannel engagement analytics.  
 Work closely with data engineering, technology, and build teams to troubleshoot data issues and provide measurement-driven feedback to enhance commercial solutions.  
 Exposure of digital platforms and data sources (e.g., Adobe Analytics, Google Analytics, marketing automation, CRM, ad platforms, Veeva) to ensure data quality, tagging accuracy, and reliable campaign reporting.  
 Ensure analytical outputs are reproducible, well-documented, and aligned with data governance, compliance, and responsible use standards.  
   
 Skills & Competencies   
 Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to translate complex analytics and engagement insights into clear business outcomes, including AI-generated findings.  
 Solid project execution and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple analytical workstreams in parallel.  
 Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills, with attention to detail, data quality, and measurement rigor.  
 Hands-on expertise in applied statistics, analytics, and advanced measurement concepts relevant to omnichannel performance.  
 Familiarity with HCP and patient engagement journeys across digital, field, and media channels.  
 Collaborative mindset with the ability to work effectively in a matrixed, stakeholder-driven environment.  
 Curiosity and passion for learning, innovation, and continuous improvement in analytics and measurement.  
 Campaign performance analysis and optimization mindset, with the ability to turn performance data into actionable campaign recommendations.  
 Understanding of digital marketing metrics and channel mechanics (e.g., email, programmatic, paid social, search, web).  
 Stakeholder management with marketing, campaign, and omnichannel teams  
   
 Experience & Qualifications   
 BA/BS required; advanced degree preferred in data science, analytics, statistics, mathematics, economics, life sciences, computer science, or engineering.  
 3–5 years of professional experience in advanced analytics, digital analytics, marketing analytics, campaign analytics, decision science, or omnichannel engagement measurement roles, ideally within an AI-driven commercial environment.  
 Proven experience delivering end-to-end analytics and measurement projects, from problem framing to insight delivery.

jobs.title: Director - SN Risk & Compliance Manager
jobs.description:
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems. Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines. Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges. 
 Job Purpose  
 The SN Risk & Compliance Manager owns the risk and compliance position of the ServiceNow and enterprise tools platform, keeping it in a state of compliance and fitness for intended use across its operational life as required by the Digital and Tech Risk-Based Integrated Software Development Lifecycle (SOP2). The role runs the Risk and Compliance Assessment that classifies platform change onto the Standard or GxP delivery track, verifies Digital Risk Navigator control attestation before release, and maintains the qualification and release evidence the platform depends on.
 The platform is unusual in that it enforces controls for the rest of Digital and Tech. The GxP, SOX, CAB required, outage and electronic signature flags in ServiceNow change management, and the risk and impact questionnaire behind them, are automated controls that other teams rely on, so a defect here is systemic rather than local. Quality assurance and testing for platform change sit with the SN QA Lead, ITSM process design and governance sit with the ITSM Process and Governance Lead, product direction sits with the Product Managers and Product Owners, platform operation sits with the SN Platform Managers, and enterprise policy is set by the Governance Risk and Compliance function.
 Key Responsibilities 
 Own the risk and compliance position of the ServiceNow and enterprise tools platform, keeping it in a state of compliance and fitness for intended use throughout its operational life.
 Represent and support the submissions for the ServiceNow and enterprise tools platform at DPTF & D&T RMCB’s
 Run the Risk and Compliance Assessment for platform and product change, initiating it at concept phase so that Standard Track or GxP Track classification is settled before design rather than discovered at release.
 Verify Digital Risk Navigator control attestation before release, and withhold release where controls assigned by the assessment have not been implemented and evidenced.
 Assure the automated compliance controls configured in ServiceNow change management, covering the GxP, SOX, CAB required, outage and electronic signature flags and the risk and impact questionnaire that drives them.
 Assure quality and compliance approval routing, so that GxP changes and changes against configuration items with documented prior agreement reach a regulatory approver rather than closing on technical approval alone.
 Maintain platform and tool qualification evidence, and the release documentation set covering plan and operations manuals and validation summary reports for both delivery tracks.
 Run periodic compliance review for the platform, and track findings and remediation through to closure rather than to acceptance.
 Complete the AI Accountability Report with the business and technology owners for platform features using artificial intelligence or machine learning, and assess the control implications before those features are enabled.
 Assure access management and privileged operations controls for the platform, including segregation of duties, given that platform administrators can alter the controls other teams are governed by.
 Produce Management Monitoring and Internal Controls Assurance evidence for the platform s controls, so that assurance is continuous rather than assembled at audit.
 Support internal audit and regulatory inspection for the platform, act as the point of contact for platform-related findings, and assess vendor capability where the supplier s documentation or services are relied on.
 Hold the boundaries with the SN QA Lead on quality assurance and testing, the ITSM Process and Governance Lead on process design, the Snr. Technical Change Manager on the enterprise change process, and the Governance Risk and Compliance function on enterprise policy.
 Education & Professional Qualifications 
 Degree in a technology, life sciences, quality or business discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
 Risk, audit or validation certifications desirable (e.g., Certified Information Systems Auditor, GAMP 5 computer system validation training, or ITIL 4 Foundation).
 Job Experience: 
 Overall 18 years and typically 8-10 years in IT risk, compliance, quality assurance or computer system validation, including at least three years in a regulated environment.
 Practical experience applying a risk-based software development lifecycle, including classifying change onto differentiated delivery tracks.
 Experience with computer system validation for configurable or software-as-a-service platforms, including qualification and release documentation.
 Experience assuring automated or configured controls, rather than only documenting manual ones.
 Track record supporting internal audit or regulatory inspection and taking findings through to closure.
 Working knowledge of ServiceNow or a comparable enterprise service management platform, sufficient to assess whether a control is configured as intended.
 Exposure to the control and accountability implications of artificial intelligence or machine learning features in a regulated platform.
 Preferred Skills: 
 Willingness to withhold a release when the evidence is not there, and to explain precisely what would satisfy the requirement.
 Precision with controlled documentation, since the record is the evidence and an inaccurate one is a finding.
 Enough platform literacy to test whether a control is genuinely configured as described rather than accepting an assurance.
 Ability to work with delivery teams as an enabler of release rather than as a gate they route around.
 Composure during audit and inspection, answering what is asked without volunteering speculation.
 Persistence on remediation after the finding has been logged and attention has moved elsewhere.

jobs.description:
About the Team: 
  
 Enterprise Systems is the backbone of GSK’s internal operations in Digital & Tech, enabling GSK Global Functions teams such as Finance, Procurement, HR, Legal, Compliance, WREF, CGA and Corporate Secretariat to run seamlessly. This team designs and delivers cutting-edge digital platforms that power critical processes, ensuring efficiency, compliance, and scalability across the enterprise.  
    
 Enterprise Systems Management & Business Operations delivers digital solutions that support Enterprise Systems running as a high-performing organisation. This team drives financial discipline, operational rigour and strategic alignment across the ES portfolio that safeguard GSK’s integrity and reputation globally. By joining this team, you’ll help shape systems that support thousands of employees worldwide, driving innovation and reliability in the tools that keep GSK moving forward. 
 Job Purpose  
 The Manufacturing Systems Analyst is the subject-matter expert for manufacturing systems, manufacturing processes and the data generated across shop-floor, laboratory and manufacturing-operations environments. The role develops a detailed understanding of how equipment, automation, historians, MES/MOM, LIMS/LES, PAT and related systems create, transform and consume data, and ensures that information is usable by Manufacturing, MSAT, Quality, CMC and R&D stakeholders. 
 The role analyses data flows across ISA-95 (International Society of Automation standard 95) Levels 2, 3 and 5 and translates manufacturing and scientific needs into clear requirements, process models, source-to-target mappings, contextualization rules, data-quality controls and acceptance criteria. The job holder works closely with FIL, automation, OT, application, data, cloud and architecture teams, providing the manufacturing-data expertise needed to design integrations and data products that preserve batch, material, asset, process, sample, method, timestamp, unit, quality and provenance context. 
 The role acts as the bridge between manufacturing and technical teams, supporting discovery, design, testing, deployment, issue investigation, and continuous improvement. It develops reusable manufacturing data definitions, mappings, analysis methods, documentation and training, while promoting consistent interpretation and use of manufacturing data across sites, products and programs. 
 Key Responsibilities  
 Analyze end-to-end business processes, system interactions and data flows across ISA-95 Level 2 equipment and control systems, Level 3 manufacturing operations systems, and Level 5 enterprise, analytics, cloud and R&D platforms. 
 Use approved AI tools in your day-to-day work to improve your own productivity and your team’s ways of working, sharing what works and applying sound judgement, including validating outputs and following GSK’s Responsible AI, privacy and security requirements. 
 Hold mappings, interface definitions and test scenarios under version control, peer-review them before release, and run scripted data-reconciliation and regression checks with the evidence kept with the change. 
 Lead functional and data investigations across manufacturing systems, escalating promptly where batch execution, product quality, patient supply, data integrity or scientific interpretation may be affected. 
 Define functional interface requirements and detailed manufacturing data mappings for automation, historians, MES (Manufacturing Execution System)/MOM (Manufacturing Operations Management), LIMS (Laboratory Information Management System)/LES (Laboratory Execution System) , PAT (Process Analytical Technology), laboratory instruments, asset systems and enterprise or scientific data platforms. 
 Analyze manufacturing records, events, tags, messages, logs, metadata and data-quality results to identify missing context, inconsistent definitions, mapping defects, data loss, duplication, timing issues and opportunities for improvement. 
 Coach site analysts, engineers, data stewards and super users in manufacturing-system processes, data interpretation, contextualization, testing and issue diagnosis. 
 Lead manufacturing-systems analysis and data workstreams across multiple projects, releases or sites. 
 Review and approve functional requirements, process models, data mappings, interface specifications, test scenarios, traceability and validation evidence for the assigned scope. 
 Provide manufacturing-process and data expertise during complex incidents, releases and stabilization, coordinating business SMEs, site teams, technical teams and suppliers. 
 Assess functional and data risks and ensure mitigation addresses process control, GxP compliance, data integrity, traceability, usability, resilience and supportability. 
 Maintain reusable manufacturing-data definitions, canonical and semantic mappings, ISA-95-aligned models, namespace conventions, business rules, data-quality rules and analysis templates. 
 Document the functional use, source structures and data semantics of industrial interfaces such as OPC UA, MQTT/Sparkplug B, APIs (Application Programming Interface), message queues, files and databases, and support technical teams in selecting appropriate integration approaches. 
 Develop and govern contextualization and semantic mappings from equipment tags and process signals to assets, materials, batches, process steps, samples, methods and products using metadata, master data, ontologies and knowledge-graph-ready relationships. 
 Specify and verify how manufacturing and laboratory data must be made available to enterprise and R&D consumers while retaining source, timestamp, unit of measure, quality status, lineage, batch and equipment context. 
 Partner with CMC, MSAT (Manufacturing Science and Technology), Data Science and R&D teams to translate scientific and process-analysis needs into scalable integration services and consumable, well-described data products. 
 Define business and data requirements for completeness, ordering, reconciliation, duplicate handling, late-arriving data, traceability and recovery where connectivity or downstream services may be interrupted. 
 Ensure manufacturing-system and data requirements reflect applicable access, segregation, security, privacy, retention, audit-trail and controlled-change expectations. 
 Lead functional risk assessments, requirements of traceability, data verification, user acceptance testing and validation support using a risk-based approach appropriate to GxP and data-integrity requirements. 
 Coordinate business readiness, cutover verification, data reconciliation, hypercare and transition to service, including data ownership, issue triage, support procedures and escalation paths. 
 Support formal technical assurance, audits and inspections and ensure corrective actions are evidence based. 
 Translate lessons from manufacturing-systems analysis and data investigations into improved requirements, data definitions and cross-team analysis practices. 
 Key Relationships / Customers  
 Business and Site Stakeholders  
 Manufacturing, Quality, Laboratory, Supply Chain and MSAT stakeholders 
 Site engineers, automation teams, super users and key users 
 Business Process Owners and operational risk owners 
 Digital & Technology Stakeholders  
 Product Managers and Product Owners 
 Solution and Enterprise Architects 
 Engineering, DevOps, Data and Integration teams 
 Service Managers, Cyber Security and Infrastructure teams 
 Validation, Quality and technical assurance teams 
 Other  
 Technology vendors 
 System integrators and specialist engineering partners 
 Managed service and support providers 
  
 Basic Qualifications: 
 Bachelor s or Master s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, Automation, Data, Life Sciences, or a relevant technical discipline.
 Minimum 5 years of experience as a manufacturing systems analyst, business systems analyst, manufacturing-data analyst, MES/LIMS analyst, automation or process-data SME supporting manufacturing or laboratory systems and data environments.
 Experience leading manufacturing-systems analysis, requirements gathering, and data-definition activities for a product family, platform, programme, or multiple sites.
 Experience reviewing or approving business and functional requirements, process models, data mappings, interface specifications, test scripts, traceability documentation, and validation evidence.
 Experience leading functional or data root-cause investigations involving manufacturing systems, interfaces, workflows, master data, and operational records.
 Experience coordinating Manufacturing, MSAT, Quality, Laboratory, Data, Engineering, site, and supplier teams through discovery, design, testing, deployment, and stabilization activities.
 Experience performing technical risk assessments and defining or tracking mitigations covering security, data integrity, resilience, compliance, and supportability.
 Experience coaching engineers or creating reusable standards, patterns, guidance, or knowledge materials based on implementation experience and lessons learned.
 Experience preparing or providing technical documentation and evidence for audits, inspections, or formal technical assurance activities.
 Experience analyzing data flows and documenting functional requirements, source-to-target mappings, and acceptance criteria between ISA-95 Level 2 systems such as PLC, SCADA, DCS, equipment, instruments, PAT, and historians and Level 3 platforms such as MES/MOM, LIMS/LES, EBR, scheduling, quality, and maintenance systems.
 Experience translating Manufacturing, MSAT, CMC, or R&D information needs into documented requirements for Level 3 manufacturing data consumed by Level 5 enterprise, cloud, analytics, data lakehouse, ontology, or knowledge graph platforms, including assessment of data fitness, context, and lineage.
 Experience analyzing data structures, semantics, quality, and interface constraints associated with OPC UA, MQTT or Sparkplug B, REST APIs, message brokers/event streaming, SQL, time-series data, and secure file or database exchange, and using that analysis to define requirements or assess interface suitability with technical specialists.
 Experience defining manufacturing information requirements and reviewing canonical models, Unified Namespace structures, topic/naming conventions, schema evolution, metadata, and master-data mappings for semantic consistency, traceability, and business use.
 Experience defining requirements and mappings that retain batch, material, asset, process, sample, method, timestamp, unit, quality, and provenance context across source and consuming systems.
 Experience defining business scenarios and data acceptance criteria for integration, performance, store-and-forward, retry, and recovery testing, and reviewing reconciliation and observability results against defined criteria for data completeness, ordering, timeliness, and integrity.
 Experience working with cloud or edge data platforms, data pipelines, version-controlled requirements or mappings, release processes, and operational support activities.

 LIMS, LES, laboratory instruments, sample/method data.
 OPC UA, MQTT, Sparkplug B.
 REST APIs, message brokers, event streaming/queues.
 UNS (Unified Namespace) , canonical information models, semantic interoperability.

 Scientific metadata, semantic modelling, ontology mapping, knowledge graphs.

 Especially regulated manufacturing/laboratory environments.

About the role 
  
 The Reporting Specialist support the Finance Controllership team in the financial accounting, controlling & reporting, controls requirements for specific market / global entity. The role supports the accuracy of P&L and Balance Sheet, provide analytics and insights that support the business to develop accurate plans in a strong controls and assurance environment.
 Role & Responsibilities 
 Working closely with the respective Controllership team to contribute to the monthly / quarterly / annual reporting of financial results and execution of controls part of the Internal Control Framework for markets / entities under responsibility.
 Providing commentaries in relation to P&L, Balance Sheet and cash flow as needed.
 Review of monthly Balance Sheet schedules & reconciliation where required. Liaise with respective stakeholders of Balance Sheet Reconciliations to resolve open items.
 Assist with aspects of financial month end review process: Manage Operating Expenditure and all reporting requirements (including Operating Expenditure & Headcount Reporting)
 Review and processing of Opex provisions, accruals, standard journals etc.
 
 Ensure entities results are fully compliant with all relevant accounting standards, policies, best practice and any other requirements in place.
 Collaborate with stakeholders and other functions (e.g. P2P, O2C, FRMC, Stat&Tax) to ensure successful closing activities.
 Perform variance analysis for Balance Sheet, Operating expenses, Margins and Profitability, review financial information against historical run rates and future growth plans.
 Participate & contribute into business reviews meetings as appropriate.
 Tightly controls transaction activity that operates in line with global processes and incorporates best practice financial controls
 Supporting internal & external Audit requirements. Ensure compliance with all requirements encompassing data integrity and evidence of process and accuracy.
 Be involved in local and global projects as required.
 Drive Continuous Improvement in the Controllership space and standardization of processes / activities in partnership with the GPO.
   
 Requirements 
 ·       At least 5-10 years of experience in similar Finance Controllership roles with expertise in areas of financial accounting, reporting and statutory filing, treasury, asset accounting, inter-company transactions, etc. with a good understanding of controls / Internal Control Framework and Tax requirements.
 ·       Good understanding of accounting principles and policies.
 ·       Experience in finance processes and associated technology platforms.
 ·       Degree in Accounting, Economics or related field and/or MBA .
 ·       Professional accounting qualification (ACCA, CIMA, CPA, ACA or equivalent) is an advantage.
 ·       Ability to connect and effectively communicate and partner with various stakeholders.
 ·       Ability to identify and resolve issues, demonstrate problem‑solving capabilities.
 ·       Ability to work effectively in a remote, multicultural and global environment supporting multiple countries / entities globally
 ·       Previous experience of working with SAP/S4Hana, Lumira, Power BI, Agentic AI is an advantage
 ·       Attention to details, good analytical and presentation skillsets.
 ·       Fluency in English is a requirement.
   
 #LI-GSK
 Skills 
Business Acumen, Cyber Risks, Data Analytics, Digital Fluency, Driving Continuous Improvement, Financial Controlling, Financial Management Reporting, Stakeholder Management

jobs.title: Senior Manager - SN Automation Engineering Product Analyst
jobs.description:
Business Introduction GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems. Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines. Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges. Job Purpose  
 The SERVICENOW Automation Engineering Product Analyst supports the delivery of secure, effective, and compliant digital solutions by translating business strategy, pain points, and regulatory needs into clear, testable requirements. Working with the Automation Engineering Architect, they help shape solution options that align to product strategy, architectural guardrails, and cost considerations. The Automation Engineering Product Analyst documents processes, designs technology-enabled use cases, and supports solution testing, adoption, and operational readiness. They contribute to continuous improvement and automation opportunities that enhance user experience, reduce effort, and enable measurable value for the Product.  In addition, this role supports the iTSM Service Catalog and will work in partnership with SERVICENOW Automation Engineering Architect for conversational/automation of forms and MSP service catalog factory for basic forms.
 Key Responsibilities 
 •        Support the Automation Engineering Architect to realise the Product strategy by eliciting and managing detailed business requirements (e.g., features, user stories) and designing technology-enabled use cases.

 •        Perform functional and non-functional testing for delivered solutions and upgrades, ensuring the system fulfils requirements; support the creation of test cases and execution using test management tooling.
 •        Support configuration release management activities, adhering to release management policy, documenting version history, deployment notes, and release checklists.
 •        Develop user guides, configuration documentation, runbooks, and training materials; deliver training to key users or support teams to enable Product adoption and support readiness.
 •        Support the Automation Engineering Architect to identify and document additional security, data privacy, and compliance considerations (e.g., sensitive data handling), liaising with relevant SMEs to embed required controls.
 •        Support onboarding into GSK systems and adherence to Portfolio and platform control requirements (e.g., compliance artefacts, access controls, operability standards).

 •        Act as an escalation point for the Application Support team, advising on complex incidents and ensuring documentation and configuration records remain accurate for effective support and maintenance.

 •       Bachelor s or Master s degree in a relevant field (e.g., Computer Science, Information Technology, or Engineering), or equivalent experience.
 •       Industry certifications highly desirable (e.g. SAP certification in related area, Agile methodologies)
 Area of Specialisation 
 •  Strong business knowledge in a relevant functional domain (e.g., IT, Finance, R&D), with the ability to analyse business challenges using structured frameworks, model end-to-end processes (e.g., BPMN), and support delivery through familiarity with Agile practices (e.g., SAFe, Scrum, Kanban).
 Experience Required 
 •       Overall 10 years and typically 2–4 years’ experience in a business analysis or product-focused role supporting technology delivery.
 •        Experience eliciting and managing detailed business requirements in operational or complex business environments; building process flows and facilitating stakeholder sessions.
 •        Demonstrated ability to analyse business problems and develop technology-enabled use cases using structured methods.
 •        Experience supporting functional testing activities, including executing test cases and managing defects through to resolution.
 •        Familiarity with software engineering concepts, security considerations, and technology solutioning is beneficial.
 •        Experience in Pharmaceuticals or other regulated industries is desirable to support compliance, data integrity, and controlled business processes.
 •        Strong communication and stakeholder engagement skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across business and technical teams.

 •        Ability to translate complex business rules into clear system behaviour, configurations, and test scenarios.
 •        Proactive and curious mindset, able to investigate system issues, validate behaviour, and identify improvement opportunities.
 •        Effective communication skills, capable of explaining system constraints and technology implications in a way business stakeholders can understand.
 •        Comfortable working in a structured, process-driven environment, with an appreciation of compliance, data integrity, and controlled change management practices.

jobs.title: Associate Director DDIT ISC AI Compliance Enablement
jobs.description:
Job Description Summary 
The Associate Director, AI Compliance Enablement will help transform how Information Security & Compliance (ISC) delivers compliance through the responsible use of AI, automation and digital technologies. The role will identify and implement opportunities to automate compliance activities, improve control monitoring and assurance, and reduce manual effort across ISC processes. It will also help translate AI governance, security and compliance requirements into scalable controls and solutions that enable Novartis to adopt AI responsibly. Working across ISC, DDIT and other key stakeholders, the role will connect compliance expertise with technology and innovation to create simpler, faster and more sustainable compliance capabilities.  
 Job Description 
 Key Responsibilities: 
 Lead the design and delivery of AI-enabled compliance capabilities, using AI, intelligent agents and automation to simplify processes and strengthen compliance outcomes.
 Shape scalable approaches for Compliance-as-Code, Governance-as-Code and Policy-as-Code, enabling more continuous and automated assurance.
 Translate AI governance, regulatory and risk management requirements into practical processes, controls and technology-enabled solutions.
 Support effective governance across the lifecycle of AI applications, models, agents and AI-enabled business processes, including risk classification, assessment, monitoring and control validation.
 Design and implement automated compliance workflows, including evidence collection, control testing, monitoring, risk assessments and evidence reviews.
 Build reusable automation capabilities across compliance domains such as information security, SOX, GxP, privacy and AI governance.
 Collaborate with security, technology, architecture and governance teams to identify and address emerging AI security, compliance and assurance risks.
 Provide product leadership for strategic compliance capabilities, partnering with engineering and platform teams to develop scalable, sustainable solutions.
 Modernize compliance processes through AI, automation, analytics and intelligent workflows, focusing on solving meaningful compliance challenges rather than simply digitizing existing processes.
 Define meaningful metrics and insights to demonstrate compliance effectiveness, control performance and automation value, while identifying opportunities for continuous improvement.
 Essential Requirements 
 University degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Risk Management, Compliance, Data Science or a related discipline. 
 Significant experience in Information Security, Compliance, IT Risk Management, Audit, Data Privacy, AI Governance or another relevant discipline. 
 Experience working within complex, global and regulated environments. 
 Strong understanding of risk management, controls and governance frameworks. 
 Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional transformation initiatives. 
 Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to connect technical, compliance and business perspectives. 
 Experience with Generative AI, AI agents or AI governance. Experience designing or implementing compliance automation. 
 Desirable Requirements 
 Understanding of Compliance-as-Code, Policy-as-Code or continuous controls monitoring concepts. Experience with technologies such as Azure AI, Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Studio, Power Platform, ServiceNow or similar platforms. 
 Experience with SOX, GxP, cybersecurity or data privacy compliance.Familiarity with emerging AI regulatory requirements, standards and risk management frameworks.

jobs.description:
Job Description Summary 
#LI-Hybrid Location: Hyderabad, India As a Senior eCompliance Manager you ensure implementation of the e-Compliance strategy and all applicable Novartis and regulatory requirements for all GxP regulated computerized systems and associated infrastructure. Provide oversight and guidance in the development and implementation of Novartis GxP computerized Systems and processes, including on-going implementation of Data Integrity technical controls within IT systems landscape. Closely cooperate with functional IT staff in the compliant development and delivery of computerized systems to meet GxP requirements. Review and approve CSV deliverables for all Global GxP relevant systems including determination of GxP applicability.  
 Job Description 
 Key Responsibilities: 
 Ensure implementation of the e-Compliance strategy and all applicable Novartis and regulatory requirements for all GxP and AI regulated computerized systems and associated infrastructure.
 Contribute to developing a future-focused strategy for AI and emerging technology readiness, evaluating regulatory requirements and developments to ensure the Novartis QMS remains fit for purpose in the eCompliance environment.
 Lead the implementation, scaling and adoption of approved automation and AI capabilities within assigned eCompliance domains.​
 Provide oversight, and guidance in the development and implementation of Novartis GxP computerized Systems and processes, including on-going implementation of Data Integrity technical controls within IT systems landscape.
 Single Point of Contact for all CSV related matters for GxP Global Computerized Systems and act as an interface between IT and Business for eCompliance topics in relation to GxP classified Computer Systems promoting a Quality Culture.
 Establish trusted partnership with assigned IT Function with understanding of business drivers, strategic roadmap and its impact on the eCompliance team.
 Review and approve project related documents for all Global GxP relevant systems including determination of GxP applicability. Review and approve High Level Classification & Consultation Document (HLCCD), standards and documents for all Global GxP and non- GxP relevant systems including determination of GxP applicability.
 Support the life-cycle of GxP computerized systems with periodic re-evaluation of the validation status, change controls, deviations management ensuring that relevant documentation is in place and maintained according to the Novartis requirements.
 Closely cooperate with functional IT staff in the compliant development and de- livery of computerized systems to meet GxP requirements.
 Provide the needed e-Compliance support for the Strategic Projects, audits and Inspections.
 Ensure that the KQIs are proactively managed.
 Support the development, maintenance and effective implementation of appropriate standards and non-contradictory processes for governing GxP computerized systems.
 Support appropriate benchmarking with industry for trends and changing regulations to ensure that the Novartis standards and requirements are sustainably maintained and aligned and compliant with current HA requirements and expectations. Integrate into internal NVS regulatory processes accordingly.
 Support the development and implementation of adequate eCompliance standards in established quality risk assessment processes to ensure that eCompliance and technical requirements for data integrity are adequately covered.
 Perform supplier qualification assessment activities.
 Essential Requirements: 
 Full time Bachelor’s or Master’s degree with 15-20 years of overall experience, and a minimum 10 years of relevant experience in the Pharmaceutical Industry and in particular within regulated functions such as IT Quality and Compliance.
 Profound understanding of global regulations and Health Authorities expectations governing computerized systems incl. computerized systems validation, lifecycle management and 21 CFR Par 11 requirements.
 Solid experience in the development, implementation and lifecycle management of computerized systems in regulated environments.
 Experience in quality management of onsite, Cloud, SaaS platform, mobile and digital application used in regulated environments.

 Experience in the development, implementation and lifecycle management of key computerized systems in the Pharmaceutical Development, Manufacturing, Quality, Commercial and Infrastructure space (e.g. ERP/SAP, MES, LIMS, CRM, IAM, etc.).
 Successful cross-divisional/functional work with complex international teams.

 Ability to effectively interact and present to Management, health authority inspectors.
 Proven ability to influence without hierarchical authority and build trusted partnerships.
 Proven self-starter with experience in initiating and delivering projects and processes.
 Excellent communication, negotiation, facilitation, and interpersonal skills.

 Proficiency in data governance, data integrity, analytics, Power BI and KPI/KQI management.
 Strong understanding of cloud/SaaS, cybersecurity, RPA, APIs, Agile/DevOps and modern computerized systems.
 Understanding of GenAI, Agentic AI, machine learning, automation, digital twins and other emerging technologies.
