jobs.title: Manager - Business Insights & Analytics
jobs.description:
Job title : Manager – Business Analytics
 Hiring Manager : Group Lead Business Analytics
 Location : Hyderabad
 % of travel expected : Travel required as per business need, if any
   
 About the job  
 Sanofi has currently the best and most robust pipeline of R&D and consequent new launches of our history. As new phase of Play-To-Win strategy, funding this pipeline and new launches is key to materialize the miracles of the science to improve people lives. Thus, as we enter the next phase, modernization of Sanofi is required as per the recent announcements on DRIVE, and in this respect, we are in the beginning stages of organizing the Go-to-Market Capabilities (GTMC) team at global level. 
 The GTMC organization will help us to drive best-in-class capabilities across the board and bring value and excellence in our commercial operations. This move is a key part of the aimed modernization of Sanofi and will allow us to focus on our priorities across our products, market and pipeline through the reallocation of resources and realizing the efficiencies of removing silos that exist between our business units, avoiding the duplication and overlapping of resources, standardizing our processes and tools, operating with a One Sanofi approach to accelerate our key capabilities development, and fostering the entrepreneurial spirit by speeding up the decision making. 
 Our Hubs are a crucial part of how we innovate, improving performance across every Sanofi department and providing a springboard for the amazing work we do. Build a career and you can be part of transforming our business while helping to change millions of lives. Ready? As a Manager Business Insights & Analytics, within our Hyderabad Hub, you ll be responsible for supporting our commercial Insights, Analytics, and Data organization we are transforming to better power decision-making across our end-to-end commercialization process, from business development to late lifecycle management. Deliverables support commercial planning and decision making across multiple countries and globally.
 Main responsibilities: 
 At Sanofi we are leveraging analytics and technology, on behalf of patients around the world. We are seeking those who have a passion for using data, analytics, and insights to drive decision making that will allow us to tackle some of the world’s greatest health threats.
 Within our commercial Insights, Analytics, and Data organization we are transforming to better power decision-making across our end-to-end commercialization process, from business development to late lifecycle management.
 Deliverables support commercial planning and decision making across multiple countries and globally.
 In addition to ensuring high-quality deliverables, our team drives synergies across the franchise, fosters innovation and best practices, and creates solutions to bring speed, scale and shareability to our planning processes. As we endeavour, we are seeking a dynamic talent for the role of “Manager – Business Analytics”.
 We are looking for a team member to support our Global analytics team. Robust insights & analytics is a priority for our businesses, as the product potential has major implications to a wide range of disciplines.
 It is essential to have someone who understands and aspires to implement innovative analytics techniques to drive our insights generation across different franchises.
 Maintain effective relationship with the end stakeholders within the allocated GBU and tasks. Actively lead the insights generation and analytics across engagement. Being the PoC and accountable overall project and stakeholder management
 Performance: 
 Works to develop deal tracking analytics and uncover actionable insights from different reporting OC dashboards to support Marketing decision making.
 Refresh Existing Reports and identifies improvement opportunities in reporting and BI tools and as needed structure / functionality with the latest insights as they become available.
 Collaborates with Digital to enhance data access across various sources, develop tools, technology, and process to constantly improve quality and productivity.
 Providing accurate, timely reporting of key brand performance indicators and business trends.
 Analyse ambiguity/uncertainty in data and produce computational methodologies to resolve missing data elements, address issues and document solutions.
 Coordinate the process and consolidation of the inputs provided from various stakeholders.
 Providing actionable analysis of performance of the commercial organization and on specific marketing initiatives including but not limited to brand resource optimization, omnichannel execution & business performance management. 
 Conduct extensive marketing analytics work including assessment of promotion tactic, content, vendor, and channel performance, analysis of customer behaviour and engagement journey to optimize customer experience. Integrating and analysing data from different sources while building visual, automated and easy to use dashboards.
 Identify and interpret business needs, analyse, and prioritize the requirements, design, and analyse data, identify gaps, and provide business requirements and expectations feedback.
 Refresh the current data structure and improve, as per the functional requirement, with the latest insights as they become available.
 Managing data and systems infrastructure ensuring data accuracy and quality.
 Responsible for tracking, analysing and reporting on marketing activities, campaigns, etc. while providing meaningful customer insights to drive business decisions.
 Perform detailed analyses to follow up and diagnose performance signals, marketing effectiveness and underlying market dynamics.
 Collaborate with other teams to identify KPIs, prioritize data gaps, ensure data accuracy, etc.
 Translate analytical findings into actionable recommendations and communicate through regular interaction with business unit teams.
 Work with stakeholders to understand changing business needs and develop solutions to meet those needs.
 Provide ad-hoc reporting and analysis as needed
 Process: 
 Support delivery of projects in terms of resourcing, coordination, quality, timeliness, efficiency, and high technical standards.
 Supporting the Insights Excellence and Product Planning team to enable forecasting/ statistical solutions that provide for automation, working closely with the brand teams and digital teams.
 Secure adherence to compliance procedures and internal/operational risk controls in accordance with all applicable standards.
 Prepare customer engagement reports on frequency/cycle basis (weekly/monthly/quarterly/annually), along with QC checks.
 Use latest tools/technologies/methodologies and partner with internal teams to provide support on all sort of regular and ad hoc business analytics activities like build, maintenance, and enhancements of such systems.
 Ability to work cross-functionally, gather requirements, analyze data, and generate insights and reports that can be used by the GBU.
 Work collaboratively with the stakeholder teams to prioritize work and deliver on time-sensitive requests.
 Be able to provide and defend gathered intelligence, methodology, content, and conclusions to the global leadership in a clear, concise format.
 Stakeholder: 
 Work closely with global and local teams and/ external vendors to ensure the end-to-end effective project delivery.
  
 About you 
 Experience: 
 6 years of experience in pharmaceutical product marketing analytics.
 Understanding of marketing analytics / KPIs and experience in generating quantitative and qualitative insights and recommendations.
 Experience with CRM Analytics, web and digital analytics (Veeva, Google Ads/Search Ads, Social Media, E-commerce, content management, Google Analytics, competitor monitoring, etc.)
 Knowledge of common databases like SQL, Databricks, advanced excel, VBA, advanced PowerPoint, Engagement and execution data, etc.
 The candidate should have a record of developing analytics to support strategic & operational planning.
 Experience in a healthcare company (pharmaceutical or biotech) or supporting organization.
 Experience with pharmaceutical data business & reporting
 An aptitude for problem solving and strategic thinking

jobs.description:
Job title : Senior Analyst – IT Application & General Controls (ITAC/ITGC) 
 
 Location: Hyderabad
 
 About the job 
 
 Join Sanofi s Internal Control & Processes Testing Center of Excellence (IC&P CoE) and play a pivotal role in safeguarding the financial integrity and digital control environment of one of the world s leading pharmaceutical companies. This is your opportunity to be at the intersection of IT audit excellence, digital transformation, and continuous innovation — with real, measurable impact. 
 
 Internal Control is a cornerstone of Sanofi s governance framework, providing reasonable assurance across three critical dimensions: 
 
 • Operational excellence — effectiveness and efficiency of operations 
 • Reporting integrity — reliability of financial and management information 
 • Regulatory compliance — adherence to applicable laws, regulations, and Sanofi policies 
 
 Our Hubs are a crucial part of how we innovate, improving performance across every Sanofi department and providing a springboard for the amazing work we do. Build a career and you can be part of transforming our business while helping to change millions of lives. Ready? As Internal Control Global Testing COE Senior Specialist within our Internal Control Global Testing COE, you’ll Support Internal Control Global Process Leads in the creation / update of test scripts for SOX & non-SOX testing through constructive feedback and sharing of best practices. Coordinate the CSA campaign by consolidating the Local Process Owners list, updating the tools and following the CSA completion and sign-off.
 We are an innovative global healthcare company with one purpose: to chase the miracles of science to improve people’s lives. We’re also a company where you can flourish and grow your career, with countless opportunities to explore, make connections with people, and stretch the limits of what you thought was possible. Ready to get started?
 
 Main responsibilities: 
 As a key pillar of Sanofi s 2nd Line of Defense, the IC&P CoE supports and challenges operational standards, guides business teams, and reports directly to ExCom on control implementation and action plans. Reporting to the IC&P CoE ITAC/ITGC Lead, the ITAC /ITGC Specialist executes both IT Application Control (ITAC) and IT General Control (ITGC) testing activities.  For ITAC scope, this includes IT Dependent controls (automated controls, key reports, interfaces), User Access Management (UAM) and Segregation of Duties (SOD) in coordination with external auditors, SOX entities, and BSC System Controls Leads.  For ITGC scope, this includes Digital SOX ITGC and High-Risk testing activities in coordination with external auditors, Digital control owners, and Digital Risk & Compliance Leads. 
 Set up and conduct SOX and CSRD ITAC & ITGC testing in coordination with external auditors, SOX entities, and BSC System Controls Leads. 
 Analyze SOC report for in-scope third parties Conduct testing of High Risk controls for Digital solutions in compliance with Digital Control Framework. Identify optimization & continuous improvement opportunities. 
 MANAGE CONTROL ENVIRONMENT: Understand in scope applications, infrastructure and third parties’ specificities. Review prior year test results and Sanofi methodology. Obtain access to applicable Sanofi systems, including Sanofi GRC system 
 MANAGE CONTROL ACTIVITIES (CSA, IC Testing, SOX testing): Contribute to process walkthroughs and interviews during the Design phase to map control flows and identify ITDs. Submit evidence requests to Control owners in alignment with agreed calendar and scope. Monitor & report any delay or issues encountered impacting testing orchestration 
 Execute and document ITGC and ITAC testing. Analyze SOC reports based on Sanofi s review methodology, report CUEC and CSOC and ensure proper testing. Conduct High risk control Testing on the scope of non-SOX IT systems.
 DRIVE CONTINUOUS IMPROVEMENT:  Identify automation opportunities within SOX, CSRD (Corporate Sustainability Reporting Directive) and IC testing processes. 
 
 
 About you 
 Experience : Minimum 2 years of experience auditing companies in SOX IT Application Controls and IT General Controls audit. Graduated College level in Audit, IT Audit or similar 
 More than 2 years in IT Audit in auditing firm or private companies in SOX IT Application Controls and IT General Controls audit. Demonstrated knowledge of SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley) compliance requirements and testing methodologies. Expert knowledge of IT General Controls (ITGC), IT Application Controls (ITAC) and IT Dependent controls (ITDs). Expertise in automated controls, key reports, interfaces, UAM and SOD 
 Experience with SOC report analysis and PCAOB requirements. Knowledge/Awareness or experience in Accounting / Financial reporting. Understanding of CSRD frameworks and reporting processes. Experience with IT Core Model solutions and ERP systems (SAP, Oracle, Workday, etc.). Experience with IT infrastructure layers (operating systems, databases). Professional certification (CISA, CIA or equivalent) preferred. Background with Big 4 audit methodology preferred 
 Education:  Engineering degree in Computer Sciences. 
 Core competencies: IT Application & General Controls (ITAC/ITGC) — design, testing, and remediation. Strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills. Financial systems and IT risk domains (GxP, Privacy, Security, SOX). SOC report analysis and third-party risk assessment. Data analytics, automation tools, and continuous monitoring techniques. 
 Interpersonal : Strong critical thinking and structured problem-solving. Confident stakeholder management and influencing skills across all levels. Excellent written and verbal communication in English. Adaptability and resilience in a fast-paced, evolving environment 
 Languages : Must be fluent (written/spoken) in English.   
 
 Why choose us?

jobs.title: Senior Consultant – Business Systems Analyst – Coupa
jobs.description:
Role Title: Senior Consultant – Business Systems Analyst – Coupa
 Location: Chennai
 We are one purpose-led global organisation. The enablers and innovators, ensuring that we can fulfil our mission to push the boundaries of science and discover and develop life-changing medicines. We take pride in working close to the cause, opening the locks to save lives, ultimately making a massive difference to the outside world.
 AstraZeneca (AZ) is in a period of strong growth and our employees have a united purpose to make a difference to patients around the world who need both our medicines and the ongoing developments from our science. In this journey AZ must continue to work across borders and with partners and new colleagues in a fast and seamless way. The ambition, size and complexity of the organisation, coupled with the opportunities afforded by new technology, has led the Board to approve a large-scale transformation programme – Axial.
 The Axial Programme will be powered by S/4HANA a new ERP (Enterprise Resource Planning) system which will be implemented right across the organisation and will provide our business with standardised processes, enhanced financial management, common data and real time reporting, transforming the way we work through our entire supply chain - from bench to patient.
 The new system will be used by more than 20,000 employees daily, is foundational to all AZ entities and is central to most core business processes. This is a once in a generation programme for AstraZeneca and will shape our ways of working globally for many years to come.
 The Axial programme needs the best talent to work in it. Whether it’s the technical skills, business understanding or change leadership, we want to ensure we have the strongest team deployed throughout. We are striving to deliver a world class change programme that leaves all employees with a fuller understanding of their role in the end-to-end nature of our global company. This programme will provide AZ with a competitive edge, to the benefit of our employees, customers and patients.
 What you’ll do 
 Business Analysis Leadership: Apply business analysis techniques and lead delivery within a global S/4HANA Finance transformation, ensuring solutions align with clear business objectives.
 Finance Capability Design: Be responsible for the design of Finance capabilities, enable seamless delivery across releases, and lead solution remediation to protect process integrity and performance.
 SAP Best Practice and Architecture: Ensure compliance with SAP best practices, maintain integrated architecture standards, and implement robust, compliant data designs that endure.
 Planning and Risk Management: Assist in project planning, proactively handle risks and interdependencies, and keep delivery on time and on budget.
 Delivery Methodologies: Organise and implement project activities using Agile or Waterfall approaches, including SAP Activate, selecting the right tool for the outcome.
 Multi-functional Solution Design: Partner with the IT Design Team to produce solution designs that meet business and multi-functional requirements without fragmenting standards.
 Global Process Alignment: Engage with Enterprise Process Owners to define IT solutions that align to standardised global processes and deliver consistent outcomes.
 Finance Process Design and Integration: Lead Finance process design during global definition, ensuring deep integration with SAP solutions and related data objects.
 Standards Development and Testing: Develop and test global standard solutions, and bring designs through governance forums and frameworks to ensure adoption and quality.
 Product and Design Integration: Work with IT Business Analysts, Product Managers, and design experts to ensure global designs are coherent, scalable, and integrated.
 Innovation with External Experts: Collaborate with partner SME to bring the best of technology and standard approaches into our solutions.
 Strategic Design Forums: Participate in cross-functional design forums to align global designs with strategic business goals and system architecture.
 Localisation within Standards: Address localisation needs during deployment while safeguarding global standardisation and maintainability.
 Documentation and Enablement: Create clear solution designs, maintain high-quality project documentation, and deliver training on relevant tools and technologies.
 Coupa Solution and Process Expertise: Apply hands-on Coupa experience to analyse, design, and support Coupa-enabled procurement and invoicing capabilities integrated with SAP S/4HANA.
 P2P and Accounts Payable Process Leadership: Bring strong end-to-end business process understanding across Procure-to-Pay (P2P) and Accounts Payable (AP), including requisitioning, purchasing, goods receipt, invoicing, matching, approvals, and payment-related dependencies.
 Coupa-to-SAP Data Mapping and Validation: Define, review, and validate Coupa versus SAP field mappings for master and transactional data; establish mapping rules, identify data gaps, reconcile interface outputs, and support defect resolution through SIT and UAT.
 Essential for the Role 
 Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field of study or equivalent experience
 Experience applying business analysis tools, techniques, and concepts (e.g., requirements management, user-centered design, business process/product design) to deliver business change
 Experience collaborating with business partners to identify and address process/product requirements and IT needs
 Experience leading discussions, identifying and documenting business IT problem statements, business process/product design, and report requirements
 Experience working with third-party suppliers/vendors and supplier solutions/products
 Experience planning and handling resources and budgets within assigned areas
 Demonstrable hands-on experience working with Coupa, including procurement and invoicing processes and integration touchpoints with SAP.
 Strong functional understanding of end-to-end Procure-to-Pay (P2P) and Accounts Payable (AP) business processes, controls, and data flows.
 Prior experience mapping Coupa fields to SAP fields for master and transactional data, with responsibility for data validation, reconciliation, interface testing, and defect analysis during SIT and UAT.
 Desirable for the Role 
 Certification in business analysis practice (preferred)
 Experience in advising business partners across one or more functional domains within the pharmaceutical industry;
 Experience in effectively communicating with and influencing individuals at various levels (e.g., peers, managers, team members)
 Experience working within a global matrix organization, including geographically dispersed teams and partners.
 When we put unexpected teams in the same room, we unleash bold thinking with the power to inspire life-changing medicines. In-person working gives us the platform we need to connect, work at pace and challenge perceptions. That s why we work, on average, a minimum of three days per week from the office. But that doesn t mean we re not flexible. We balance the expectation of being in the office while respecting individual flexibility. Join us in our unique and ambitious world.
 Why AstraZeneca? 
 At Astrazeneca we’re dedicated to being a Great Place to Work. Where you are empowered to push the boundaries of science and unleash your entrepreneurial spirit. There’s no better place to make a difference to medicine, patients and society. An inclusive culture that champions diversity and collaboration, and always committed to lifelong learning, growth and development. We’re on an exciting journey to pioneer the future of healthcare.
 So, what’s next? 
 Are you already imaging yourself joining our team? Good, because we can’t wait to hear from you.
 Are you ready to bring new ideas and fresh thinking to the table? Brilliant! We have one seat available and hope its yours
 If you’re curious to know more then we welcome your application. Apply now!
 Where can I find out more? 
 Our Social Media

 Follow AstraZeneca on Instagram https://www.instagram.com/astrazeneca_careers/?hl en

15-Oct-2026

jobs.description:

We offer uniquely interesting and meaningful work, opportunities for growth, and a supportive environment that values inclusion, wellbeing, flexibility, and comprehensive benefits. This is work that transforms the lives of patients, and the careers of those who do it.
 Manager, PDS BI&T Analytics Operations 
  
 Summary:
 This role will play a crucial role in managing a team that supports operational analytics across PDS to ensure products continue to serve most pressing PDS analytics needs, with potential opportunities to build new advanced analytics capabilities to build in state of art solutions. Manager for this cutting-edge Analytics team should have a strong interest in solving business problems, and an eagerness to work on all parts of the analytics value chain, from partnering with IT on data pipelines to scaling and deploying analytics solution (having a thorough knowledge in Business Intelligence Space) in the service of our patients around the world. 
  
 Roles & Responsibilities: 
 •       Operate with a high degree of independence and accountability—setting priorities, making critical decisions, and delivering outcomes with minimal supervision.
 •       Provide strategic and technical analytical solutions for the identification, development, and deployment of Data & Analytics solutions across PDS BI&T, ensuring alignment with organizational objectives and enterprise initiatives as well as harmony with BMS enterprise platforms and governance (e.g., model/platform reuse, safety & privacy reviews, data access controls, usage/cost monitoring).
 •       Conduct analysis and interpretation of complex data sets to derive meaningful insights and recommendations based on an understanding of PDS priorities, critical issues, and value levers.
 •       Collaborate with stakeholders to identify business problems, goals, and KPIs to design, establish and maintain data pipelines, models and business facing reports and dashboards.
 •       Identify and implement enhancement and automation of high-value analytics while ensuring they continue to function efficiently.
 •       Collaborate proactively with IT teams to develop and enhance data infrastructure, data pipelines, and analytical tools for efficient data collection, processing, and analysis.
 •       Prepare reports, dashboards, and presentations to communicate analyses to stakeholders at various levels of the organization.
 •       Follow technical best practices in building, maintaining, and enhancing analytics output with scalable solutions, including code version control, pipeline management, deployment, and documentation.
 Continuously monitoring emerging AI technologies and best practices, recommending new approaches to drive continuous improvement and proposing a pragmatic roadmap for scaling Data Science & AI functions.
 •       Provide training, guidance, and mentorship to junior analysts and team members when required.
 •       Work hours that provide sufficient overlap with standard east coast US working hours.
  
 Skills and competencies: 
 •       Good critical thinking and problem-solving abilities to support and articulate a data-led approach to insight development with 8 years of experience
 •       Agile problem-solving ability and desire to learn new things and continuously improve
 •       Proficiency in Power BI, Databricks, SQL, Python
 •       Strong project management skills and the ability to work independently or as part of a team
 •       Solid understanding of digital analytics tools and platforms and version control like Github
 •       Strong communication skills with the ability to present complex information to non-technical stakeholders in a clear manner.
 •       Strong business acumen and strategic thinking, with the ability to translate analytical findings into actionable insights and recommendations
 •       Leadership skills to lead an analytics team with required people manager skills and positive attitude to develop the team
 Experience: 
 •      Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related scientific discipline field.
 •      Experience working as both a technical lead and people manager
 •      Proven experience in a data and analytics role, including direct development experience.
 •      Experience working with large datasets, data visualization tools, statistical software packages and platforms
 Proficiency in Python and machine learning as well as LLM and agentic AI solutions
 •      Demonstrable Experience in development of integration of generative AI or large-scale automation tools—preferably in life sciences, biotech, or healthcare.
 •      Experience with major PDS applications (SAP, Oracle, LIMS, Infinity, MES) is a plus.
 •      Experience with biotech product development, manufacturing operations, supply chain, and quality control is a significant plus.
 •      Experience in the biopharma industry a plus.

About the Team: 
 Enterprise Systems is the backbone of GSK’s internal operations in Digital & Tech, enabling GSK Global Functions teams such as Finance, Procurement, HR, Legal, Compliance, WREF, CGA and Corporate Secretariat to run seamlessly. This team designs and delivers cutting-edge digital platforms that power critical processes, ensuring efficiency, compliance, and scalability across the enterprise.      
   
 Legal, Compliance & WREF Digital & Tech delivers digital solutions that support Legal & Compliance and Workplace Real Estate & Facilities (WREF). This team drives product roadmaps and manages platforms that safeguard GSK’s integrity and reputation globally. By joining this team, you’ll help shape systems that support thousands of employees worldwide, driving innovation and reliability in the tools that keep GSK moving forward. 
 Job Purpose: 
 The Legal, Compliance WREF Architect is responsible for designing, governing, and maintaining data architecture across Legal, Compliance and Workplace Real Estate & Facilities (WREF) domains, ensuring that data models, data flows, and integrations follow enterprise data and architecture standards while supporting Legal, Compliance & WREF-specific business needs. The role ensures data is structured, secure, and interoperable across products within Legal, Compliance & WREF, evaluating upstream and downstream impacts of solution changes, and guiding delivery teams on best practice. The Legal, Compliance WREF Architect aligns domain data platforms and data products to enterprise principles, enabling trusted, scalable, and well-engineered data solutions that support analytics, operational processes, and decision-making within the domain. The role is accountable for some critical data products in Legal & Compliance aligned to Compliance Risk Analytics and Corporate Investigations.

 Syneos Health® is a leading fully-integrated life sciences services organization built to accelerate customer success. We partner with innovators at every point across the drug development and commercialization continuum, helping them navigate complexity, anticipate change and accelerate progress.   Every day we perform better because of how we work together, as one team, each the best at what we do. We bring together talented experts across a broad spectrum of business critical corporate functions. Every role plays an essential part in enabling our customers to achieve their goals. Our teams are agile, collaborative, and committed to delivering—for each other, for our customers, and ultimately for the people who rely on the services we support. Discover what your 25,000 future colleagues already know:   Why Syneos Health • We are passionate about developing our people, through career development and progression; supportive and engaged line management; technical and therapeutic area training; peer recognition and total rewards program. • We are committed to building an inclusive culture – where you can authentically be yourself. Central to this is our purpose – Driven to Deliver – which captures the passion of our colleagues to show up each day and shape solutions that have the ability to dramatically impact someone’s life.  • We are continuously building the company we all want to work for and our customers want to work with. Why? Because we know that when we bring together smart colleagues from across the world, we can shape the future of healthcare, driving impact for customers and defining the pace of patient progress. 
 
 Job Responsibilities 
 
 Title : Senior Technical Analyst (Go-To-Market and AI Technologies) (Salesforce/Azure) 
 Education Requirements: 
 Minimum 4 Year / Bachelor s degree in computer science, information 
 technology, engineering, or related field. 
 Experience : 
 5 years of experience in enterprise application engineering, solution architecture, technical leadership, or related technology roles. 
 2 years designing and delivering AI, machine learning, or generative AI solutions, including production implementations rather than prototypes alone. 
 Experience leading architecture, solution design, development, testing, deployment, integration, and ongoing support across multiple products. 
 Experience delivering technology supporting sales, marketing, and deal-management processes, including: 
 
 Prospecting, account planning, opportunity management, pipeline, and forecasting. 
 Campaigns, account-based marketing, lead management, digital engagement, and attribution. 
 Proposals, RFPs, pricing, approvals, contracting, and document generation. 
 
 
 Strong experience with Salesforce or a comparable enterprise CRM, including platform architecture, security, automation, data models, APIs, and integrations. 
 Experience with enterprise AI platforms such as Salesforce Agentforce, Microsoft Copilot/Azure AI Foundry, Databricks, or comparable technologies. 
 Experience integrating CRM, customer-data platforms, data lakes, content repositories, marketing platforms, sales-enablement tools, and deal-management systems. 
 Experience leading internal engineers, external partners, and multidisciplinary delivery teams. 
 Demonstrated success modernizing platforms, reducing technical debt, improving reliability, and transitioning solutions into sustainable operational support. 
 Experience operating in a complex, global, or regulated enterprise environment is preferred. 
 
 AI Skills Deep understanding of generative AI architecture, including large language models, agentic workflows, model orchestration, tool calling, and multi-agent patterns. 
 Experience designing retrieval-augmented generation solutions using structured and unstructured enterprise data. 
 Knowledge of document ingestion, parsing, chunking, embeddings, vector search, semantic retrieval, metadata, and enterprise knowledge management. 
 Ability to determine when to use prompting, retrieval, deterministic automation, predictive models, shared agents, or end-to-end AI solutions. 
 Experience with prompt design, reusable prompt templates, grounding, context management, and response-quality optimization. 
 Ability to design AI evaluation frameworks covering accuracy, relevance, completeness, groundedness, hallucination, latency, cost, and user acceptance. 
 Experience implementing human-in-the-loop controls, confidence thresholds, citations, approvals, and exception-handling processes. 
 Strong knowledge of responsible AI, privacy, intellectual-property protection, model risk, data security, and regulatory controls. 
 Experience monitoring production AI solutions for quality, drift, usage, performance, cost, and unintended outcomes. 
 Understanding of model selection and the tradeoffs among commercial models, open models, platform-native AI, and custom development. 
 Ability to design reusable AI services and patterns that can support multiple GTM products and avoid unnecessary duplication. 
 
 Technical Skills Strong solution- and integration-architecture skills, including APIs, event-driven patterns, middleware, authentication, authorization, and identity management. 
 Strong understanding of data architecture, master data, data quality, lineage, metadata, and governance. 
 Experience with cloud architecture, software engineering standards, source control, automated testing, CI/CD, DevSecOps, and release management. 
 Ability to establish nonfunctional requirements for security, scalability, availability, maintainability, performance, and disaster recovery. 
 Experience diagnosing complex production issues and establishing monitoring, incident-management, and support processes. 
 Ability to evaluate configuration, custom development, platform capabilities, and third-party products and recommend the appropriate approach. 
 Working knowledge of Agile delivery and product development lifecycle practices. 
 Ability to translate product roadmaps and business outcomes into technical strategies, architecture decisions, delivery plans, and engineering backlogs. 
 Strong technical leadership, including design reviews, engineering standards, mentoring, quality oversight, and resolution of cross-platform dependencies. 
 Ability to collaborate effectively with product managers while maintaining clear accountability: product leaders define the business outcomes and priorities; the technical lead owns how solutions are designed, built, operated, and evolved. 
 Strong communication skills and the ability to explain complex AI and architecture decisions to business and executive audiences. 
 Ability to influence Sales, Marketing, Deal Management, Data, Security, Privacy, Legal, and enterprise architecture stakeholders. 
 Strong vendor and implementation-partner management skills. 
 Ability to balance delivery speed with scalability, security, user experience, cost, and long-term maintainability.

 Over the past 5 years, we have worked with 94% of all Novel FDA Approved Drugs, 95% of EMA Authorized Products and over 200 Studies across 73,000 Sites and 675,000 Trial patients.
 
 No matter what your role is, you’ll take the initiative and challenge the status quo with us in a highly competitive and ever-changing environment. Learn more about Syneos Health.

jobs.title: Associate Director, Digital Investigations, Analytics & Insider Threat
jobs.description:
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems. 
 Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines. 
 Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges. Job Purpose: 
 The Associate Director, Digital Investigations, Analytics & Insider Threat will lead a defined area of the Digital Investigations, Analytics & Insider Threat capability, with insider threat operations as the priority focus, and the team or programme that delivers it. This is a leadership role accountable for running current insider threat operations and for setting the strategic direction for the agentic AI framework that will optimise and automate the prevention, detection and response to insider threat events.
 About the team: 
 The Digital Investigations, Analytics and Insider Threat team runs GSK’s insider threat program end to end, detecting, investigating and responding to threats from those who already have authorised access, and protecting GSK intellectual property and confidential business information from insider risk. The team also covers digital forensics and investigative analytics in support of insider threat and related casework. Alongside running current operations, the team is building an agentic AI framework to optimise and automate the prevention, detection and response to insider threat events, and every role in the team contributes to its development.
 Key responsibilities: 
 This role will provide you the opportunity to lead key activities to progress your career. These responsibilities include some of the following:
 Lead a defined area of the capability, including its people, delivery and outcomes, with insider threat operations as the priority.
 Own the strategy to deter, detect and respond to threats against GSK intellectual property and confidential business information.
 Oversee digital investigations into suspected policy violation, data theft and insider activity, and the tactical analysis that detects insider threat indicators.
 Oversee the tuning of detection logic across DLP and UEBA platforms and the data pipelines (HR, access, endpoint, email and cloud telemetry) that feed the analytics layer.
 Carry out insider threat risk assessments across business units, functions and scenarios.
 Own the roadmap for the team’s agentic AI framework: set the strategic direction for using agentic AI to optimise and automate insider threat prevention, detection and response, secure stakeholder buy-in and investment, and govern the responsible, compliant use of AI in investigations.
 Manage delivery against the capability roadmap and escalate blockers early.
 Develop team capability through coaching, review and structured feedback.
 Represent the area in CSO governance and cross-functional forums.
 Basic Qualifications: 
 Degree in a relevant discipline, or related experience.
 Demonstrated experience in digital investigations, insider threat or corporate investigations.
 Working knowledge of investigative analytics and case handling.
 Practical experience with DLP and UEBA platforms.
 Significant experience in cyber security within the relevant domain.
 Proven experience leading a team or a substantial programme of work.
 Experience managing delivery to plan, quality and timelines.
 Excellent relationship management, influencing and communication skills.
 Preferred Qualifications: 
 Hands-on experience with Data Loss Prevention and User and Entity Behavior Analytics platforms.
 Experience with digital forensics tooling and evidence handling.
 Experience handling matters with HR and Legal involvement.
 Statistical analysis and data visualization skill.
 Relevant certification such as CERT Insider Threat Program Manager, GCITP, GCFA, GCFE, CISSP, CompTIA Security .
 Experience in pharmaceutical, life sciences or another highly regulated industry.
 Experience leading AI or automation transformation initiatives within a security or risk function.
 Typical tools and technologies: DLP, UEBA, EDR, SIEM, forensic imaging and analysis tooling, case management platforms.

jobs.title: Senior Analyst, Perception Analytics & Insights
jobs.description:
At Bristol Myers Squibb, our employees often ask, “Who are you working for?”—a question that fuels collaboration, accountability, and urgency in our work. Our purpose-driven culture inspires us to discover, develop, and deliver innovative medicines to prevail over serious diseases. We offer uniquely interesting and meaningful work, opportunities for growth, and a supportive environment that values inclusion, wellbeing, flexibility, and comprehensive benefits. This is work that transforms the lives of patients, and the careers of those who do it.
 Position Summary: 
 The Senior Analyst, Perception Analytics and Insights, enables high-impact insight generation for the Perception Analytics group by driving advanced analytics across internal and external (social/digital) data sources. The role partners with cross-functional stakeholders to translate business questions into scalable analytical approaches. The senior analyst focuses on structuring and analyzing diverse datasets, applying business context to support tailored analyses. The role also leverages AI/ML techniques to extract meaningful signals from unstructured data and applies AI-enabled approaches such as thematic synthesis and pattern detection to accelerate insights. Additionally, the analyst contributes to reporting and innovation initiatives, with a focus on enhancing analytical depth, scalability, and decision impact through AI-driven methodologies
 Roles & Responsibilities 
 Partner with business stakeholders and analytics teams to shape and deliver advanced analytics and AI-led approaches that enable data-driven decision-making.
 Work with large-scale structured and unstructured datasets (e.g., clinical data, publications, real-world evidence, and digital signals) to uncover insights aligned to key business questions.
 Apply predictive modeling and advanced analytical techniques to identify patterns, generate foresight, and support strategic and operational decisions.
 Leverage large language models (LLMs) and AI capabilities to enhance insight generation, including thematic analysis, knowledge synthesis, and narrative development for stakeholder-ready outputs.
 Enable analytics-driven AI use cases, such as knowledge-grounded querying, retrieval-based insight discovery (RAG), and intelligent assistants that improve access to insights.
 Shape and maintain semantic layers, taxonomies, and contextual frameworks to ensure consistent interpretation of data across analytics use cases.
 Define and apply evaluation approaches to assess quality, accuracy, and reliability of analytics outputs and AI-generated insights, including mitigation of bias and hallucination.
 Collaborate with data engineering and platform teams to ensure availability of high-quality, analytics-ready data and scalable workflows supporting repeatable insight generation.
 Translate complex analyses into clear, actionable insights through concise storytelling, visualizations, and executive-ready presentations for both technical and non-technical audiences.
 Skills and competencies 
 Strong foundation in machine learning and predictive analytics, with ability to solve complex business problems using data-driven approaches.
 Proficiency in Python and SQL, with experience working on large datasets and building scalable analytical workflows on modern platforms (e.g., Databricks, Spark).
 Hands-on experience leveraging LLMs and AI techniques for analytics, including retrieval-augmented insights, text analytics, and knowledge synthesis from unstructured data.
 Understanding of embedding-based approaches, vector search, and semantic data modeling, enabling contextual analytics and improved insight discovery.
 Familiarity with agentic AI frameworks, multi-step workflows, and LLMOps practices (prompt design, evaluation, monitoring) to support scalable AI-driven analytics.
 Strong communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to translate complex analytical and AI concepts into actionable insights for diverse stakeholders.
 Experience 
 BA/BS required; advanced degree preferred with special consideration for degrees in life/physical sciences, applied sciences (computer science, mathematics, data science), or engineering
 3-5 years career experience preferred, including 2 years of experience in data analytics. 
 Ability to translate business questions into actionable analytics and reporting
 Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to simplify complex information
 Proven ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced, matrixed environment
 Technical Skills (Preferred) 
 Strong foundation in analytics, machine learning, and predictive methods to solve complex business problems
 Proficiency in SQL, Python/R, with experience working on large datasets using Databricks/Spark and visualization tools such as Power BI
 Experience applying AI/ML, NLP, and text analytics to extract insights from structured and unstructured data
 Ability to integrate new tools, AI capabilities, and advanced analytics techniques into complex environments
 We hire for skills and capabilities, not just credentials – if this role excites you, but doesn’t perfectly match your resume, we encourage you to apply anyway. 
 How We Work 
 Where you work matters – because collaboration, innovation and patient impact happen in many settings. Our roles are structured across four work models: site-essential, site-by-design, field-based and remote-by-design. The model assigned to this role is based on its core responsibilities. jobs.description:
Career Category 
Process Development 
 Job Description 
 How might you defy imagination? 
 At Amgen, our shared mission to serve patients drives all that we do. In this vital role, you will join Amgen s Transformative Digital Capabilities (TDC) organization within Process Development and help accelerate digital transformation through analytics, data products, and AI-enabled solutions. 
 What will you do  
 As a Data Scientist, you will partner with scientists, engineers, business stakeholders, and technology teams to unlock the value of Process Development data. You will lead analytical initiatives that improve decision-making, increase data accessibility and usability, and enable scalable digital and AI capabilities across Process Development. You will work across a range of initiatives spanning data strategy, advanced analytics, process optimization, digital products, and data science solutions that improve business outcomes and accelerate innovation. 
 A successful candidate will independently manage multiple assignments, anticipate and prevent potential problems, develop practical solutions aligned to operational objectives, and provide guidance to other professionals. 
 Job Requirements  
 Partner with stakeholders to identify and prioritize opportunities where analytics, AI, or data science can drive measurable value. 
 Lead the design and development of analytical solutions, dashboards, models, and data products that support scientific and business decision-making. 
 Apply statistical, machine learning, and data science methods to solve complex business and scientific problems. 
 Drive exploratory analysis, trend analysis, forecasting, and modeling using multiple sources of data. 
 Contribute to the development and deployment of AI-enabled solutions, including machine learning and generative AI use cases where appropriate. 
 Improve data accessibility, usability, quality, and stewardship in partnership with data, product, and engineering teams. 
 Translate business problems into analytical approaches, define success metrics, and communicate recommendations to technical and non-technical audiences. 
 Lead or co-lead small projects or workstreams and provide guidance to peers on analytical methods and best practices. 
 Help shape standards and repeatable approaches for analytics, visualization, and data science delivery. 
 Stay current with emerging technologies, data science methodologies, and industry best practices and apply them pragmatically to Amgen s environment.

 Master s degree OR Bachelor s degree and 7 - 11 years of relevant experience

 Experience applying data science, analytics, or statistical methods to solve complex business or scientific problems.

 Experience developing and deploying analytical models, decision-support tools, or data products.

jobs.title: BI Lab Manager
jobs.description:
Job Description
 
 Ecolab seeks a business-centric analytics professional who excels at turning ambiguous questions into actionable insights and has deep expertise in evolving those insights into scalable, production-ready solutions.
 
 This role is the leader of a small team that sits at the intersection of business strategy, data, and product thinking. The primary strength of this role is the ability to quickly understand business context, translate it into meaningful metrics and analyses, and deliver relevant outputs that move decision-making forward.
 In addition to leading the team, this individual will work iteratively with a variety of stakeholders across the enterprise. The day-to-day may include rapidly prototyping analyses, tools, or visualizations, refining them with stakeholders, and ultimately identifying which solutions should be scaled. As solutions mature, they will partner with BI developers and data engineers to operationalize them.
 
 The person in this role will either facilitate the start of scaled solutions or they may contribute to hands-on delivery of scaled solution.
 Success in this role is defined not by technical complexity, but by the ability to deliver relevant, impactful, data solutions.
 
 Key Responsibilities:
 Translate business needs into data-driven solutions Engage stakeholders to understand goals, context, and constraints
 Identify the most relevant questions, metrics, and drivers of value
 
 Rapidly prototype insights and analytical tools Move quickly from problem definition to gathering data to delivering an insight.
 Deliver early versions of analyses, dashboards, models, or lightweight tools either via PowerPoint, PowerBI, Streamlit, or custom AI tools.
 Iterate based on feedback to refine usefulness and clarity
 
 
 Apply the appropriate analytical approach Determine when to use visualization, statistical analysis, modeling, or simple heuristics to a business problem.
 Balance speed, rigor, and usability based on the situation (including the maturity of the question and the needs of the business).
 
 Perform data transformation and analysis Use SQL or Python to source, clean, and transform data into useable data for analysis. If engaged in scaling data transformation, leverage dbt to create a scaled and tested data model for consumption.
 
 Design meaningful metrics and outputs Define metrics that align with real business outcomes. Work with stakeholders to understand gaps in metric definitions or propose functional alternatives.
 Ensure outputs are interpretable, actionable, and relevant to business needs.
 
 Evolve prototypes into scalable solutions Translate prototypes into clear requirements for BI developers and data engineers
 Partner cross-functionally to scale solutions into production
 Sometimes contribute to scaled products.
 
 Operate flexibly between guidance and execution Provide direction and oversight when resources allow
 Contribute hands-on development when needed in resource-constrained environments
 
 Drive insight-led decision-making Use outputs to guide and advance stakeholder conversations
 Continuously refine questions and approaches through iteration
 
 Team Leadership Coach direct reports and “dotted line” analysts on ways to improve solution development.
 
 Required Qualifications:
 12 years of experience in analytics, business intelligence, or data science
 3-5 Years of Direct People Management Experience
 Strong proficiency in SQL for data extraction and transformation
 Proficiency in Python for data manipulation, analysis, or prototyping
 Experience with data visualization tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau, Looker, or similar)
 Demonstrated ability to translate business problems into analytical approaches and solutions
 Experience working directly with stakeholders and iterating on analytical outputs
 Strong problem-framing and prioritization skills, with a focus on business impact
 Preferred Qualifications:
 Experience with dbt for data transformation and modeling
 Experience building lightweight applications or prototypes using tools such as Streamlit.
 Familiarity with semantic models in Snowflake
 Experience with AI-enabled analytics tools such as Snowflake Cortex Agent or Databricks Genie.
 Experience implementing or supporting data quality testing frameworks.
 Exposure to product-oriented thinking in analytics (e.g., scaling dashboards, tools, or data products)
 Ability to translate exploratory work into structured requirements for engineering teams
 Experience with GitHub or other CI/CD pipeline tools.
 Experience using Claude Code or similar GenAI development tools.

 Bring the miracles of science to life alongside a supportive, future-focused team.

jobs.title: Business Performance & Analytics Analyst
jobs.description:
Career Category 
Supply Chain 
 Job Description 
 Role Summary 
 The Business Performance & Analytics Analyst supports the Global Planning Network and site Supply Chain organizations by delivering business intelligence, analytics, reporting, visualization, financial insights, and digital solutions that enable data-driven decision making across the end-to-end supply chain.
 The role partners with Global Supply Planning, Raw Materials Planning, Manufacturing, Procurement, Logistics, Finance, Digital Technology, and Site Supply Chain Operations to transform operational, planning, and financial data into actionable business insights. This position is responsible for developing enterprise reporting, performance dashboards, planning analytics, KPI scorecards, and automation solutions that improve forecast accuracy, inventory optimization, manufacturing performance, service levels, operational efficiency, and business outcomes.
 The analyst also supports continuous improvement initiatives through process standardization, automation, AI-enabled analytics, and self-service reporting capabilities while ensuring data integrity, governance, and compliance.
 Key Responsibilities 
 1. Business Performance & Analytics 
 ·        Develop and maintain enterprise dashboards, KPI scorecards, and performance reporting that support the Global Planning Network and Site Supply Chain organisations.
 ·        Analyse operational, planning, manufacturing, inventory, procurement, logistics and financial data to identify trends, risks, opportunities and performance improvement initiatives.
 ·        Deliver recurring and ad hoc analytics to support Integrated Business Planning (IBP), S&OP, operational reviews, governance forums and executive decision-making.
 ·        Translate complex data into actionable business insights and recommendations for both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
 ·        Develop executive-level visualisations that improve business visibility and support strategic planning.
 ·        Strong Data Analytics experience (problem-solving and data-to-insight storytelling)
 ·        Python, SQL, and Databricks
 ·        Tableau/Power BI
 ·        Supply Chain domain experience
 Strong experience in data visualization (Tableau/Power BI), with some exposure to Python/Databricks, along with Supply Chain domain experience
  
 2. Planning Network Analytics 
 Provide analytics and reporting support across Demand Planning, Supply Planning, Raw Materials Planning, Inventory Planning and Integrated Business Planning processes.
 Monitor, analyse and report planning performance metrics including:
   
 Supply Planning 
 Supply / Production Plan Adherence
 Capacity Utilisation and Constraints
 Network Inventory Performance
 Inventory Health and Abnormal Scrap
 Raw Materials Planning 
 Material Availability
 Supplier Performance
 Purchase Order Adherence
 Inventory Health, Ageing, Excess and Obsolete Materials
 Raw Material Supply Risk Indicators
 Partner with planning teams to identify opportunities to improve forecast accuracy, inventory optimisation, service levels and supply reliability.
 3. Site Supply Chain Analytics 
 Provide analytics and reporting that support manufacturing execution, inventory management, warehousing, operational planning, inspection readiness and continuous improvement initiatives.
 Key responsibilities include:
 Monitor and report inventory levels across all stages of manufacturing and supply.
 Analyse warehouse utilisation, inventory health and abnormal scrap performance.
 Support operational reviews through the delivery of timely analytics, business insights and performance reporting.
 Manage and maintain key site supply chain reports, dashboards and visualisation tools.
 Generate data extracts and analytics supporting operational reviews, regulatory inspections, business continuity activities and site performance management.
 4. Supply Chain Systems & Digital Solutions 
 Provide functional support and continuous improvement for supply chain systems, data, reporting platforms and system integrations.
 Key responsibilities include:
 Support SAP Supply Chain processes including Warehouse Management (WM), Production Planning (PP), Order-to-Cash (OTC), Master Data and Quality Management.
 Provide functional support for SAP GUI transactions, SAP Fiori applications and connected platforms including MES, Maximo and Ariba. 
 Troubleshoot user issues, reporting discrepancies, system errors and interface-related challenges.
 Support user access management, testing activities, documentation, training and user adoption initiatives.
 Partner with Digital Technology, SAP functional and technical teams to implement enhancements, resolve issues and improve system performance.
 Design, develop and maintain reporting and visualisation solutions using Tableau, Power BI, SAP Analytics Cloud or similar platforms. 
 Develop self-service reporting capabilities and automate recurring reporting processes to improve efficiency and business visibility.
 5. Financial Analytics, Continuous Improvement & Automation 
 Support supply chain financial performance while driving process optimisation, automation and data-driven decision making.
 Key responsibilities include:
 Support budgeting, forecasting, accrual management, invoice reconciliation, cost centre management, logistics charges and budget performance tracking.
 Analyse and reconcile operational and financial data to identify cost drivers, forecast spend and assess budget adherence.
 Partner with Finance and business stakeholders to understand financial impacts associated with inventory, manufacturing, logistics and scrap performance.
 Drive process simplification, standardisation and automation initiatives that improve operational efficiency and reporting effectiveness.
 Leverage AI-enabled analytics, predictive insights and digital technologies to enhance business performance and decision-making.
 Improve data quality, governance and reporting consistency across planning and operational processes.
 Support the development of innovative analytics solutions, digital dashboards and enterprise performance measurement capabilities.
 Basic Qualifications 
 Master s degree  OR Bachelor s degree and 5-9 years of experience in Business Analytics, Data Analytics, Supply Chain, Operations, Finance, or related business functions.
 Preferred Qualifications 
 ·        Experience supporting Supply Chain Planning, Manufacturing, Procurement, Logistics, Operations, or related business functions.
 ·        Knowledge of Supply Planning, Inventory Planning, Raw Materials Planning, and Integrated Business Planning (IBP) processes.
 ·        Experience with SAP platforms (S/4HANA, ECC, Fiori, IBP) and business intelligence tools such as Tableau, Power BI, SAP Analytics Cloud, or BusinessObjects.
 ·        Proficiency in data analytics and reporting tools, including SQL, Python, Databricks, Excel, or similar technologies.
 ·        Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to translate data into actionable business insights.
 ·        Experience driving process improvement, automation, AI-enabled analytics, and digital transformation initiatives in a complex business environment.
 ·        Experience building dashboards, KPIs, and analytics/reporting solutions
 ·        Strong stakeholder management, communication skills, and Continuous improvement mindset
 ·        Rapid Response experience
 ·        Good-to-have: Pharma domain experience
 
 
 
.

jobs.title: Encryption Agility Analyst
jobs.description:
Career Category 
Information Systems 
 Job Description 
 Role Name: Senior Associate Information Security - Encryption Agility Analyst 
 Job Posting Title: Senior Associate Information Security - Encryption Agility Analyst
 
 Department Name: Trusted Core Technologies
 
 ABOUT AMGEN 
 Amgen harnesses the best of biology and technology to fight the world s toughest diseases, and make people s lives easier, fuller and longer. We discover, develop, manufacture and deliver innovative medicines to help millions of patients. Amgen helped establish the biotechnology industry more than 40 years ago and remains on the cutting-edge of innovation, using technology and human genetic data to push beyond what s known today.
 
 ABOUT THE ROLE 
 Role Description: 
 The Senior Associate Information Security - Encryption Agility Analyst will support Amgen s enterprise Encryption Agility Service for Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC) Readiness Preparation. This role supports the Senior Manager Information Security - Encryption Agility Service Lead, the Senior Specialist Information Security - Encryption Agility Team Architect, and Global Career Framework level 5 (L5) engineers by helping collect, validate, document, and report cryptographic inventory and remediation data across Amgen. The role contributes to the Cryptographic Bill of Materials (CBOM), discovery workflows, data quality controls, ticket tracking, dashboards, and operational documentation that enable Amgen to manage encryption, cryptography, crypto agility, and post-quantum readiness across applications, cloud, infrastructure, identity, Public Key Infrastructure (PKI), certificates, Key Management Services (KMS), secrets, data protection, Software as a Service (SaaS), and third-party ecosystems.
 This position is hands-on and detail-oriented. The analyst will review tool outputs, support evidence collection, maintain inventory records, assist with false-positive triage, prepare reporting views, document remediation status, and coordinate with service owners. The role will work with Digital Identity Access Service (DIAS), PKI and certificate service owners, Application Security, Artificial Intelligence (AI) Security, Enterprise Architecture, cloud, infrastructure, platform, Risk and Compliance, Procurement, Legal, Third Party Risk Management (TPRM), Operational Technology (OT), and vendor teams while escalating complex cryptographic design or exception decisions to the L5 engineer, Principal Architect, or Senior Manager.
 The role should also support the adoption of Artificial Intelligence (AI)-enabled process orchestration within the Encryption Agility Service by helping document manual workflows, identify repetitive analysis or reporting tasks, test AI-assisted outputs, and support human-in-the-loop review activities. The analyst may assist Global Career Framework level 5 (L5) engineers and the Principal Architect with AI agent-enabled workflows that improve Cryptographic Bill of Materials (CBOM) data quality, remediation tracking, dashboard preparation, evidence review, and service documentation.
 Roles & Responsibilities: 
 Support Encryption Agility Service operations, including intake processing, work tracking, dashboard updates, meeting notes, service documentation, Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) maintenance, reporting inputs, and service improvement actions.
 Collect and validate cryptographic inventory data from source code, binaries, cloud key services, endpoints, file systems, network traffic, PKI and certificates, KMS and secrets, vendor attestations, Software Bill of Materials (SBOM) inputs, and Subject Matter Expert (SME) interviews.
 Maintain CBOM records using CycloneDX 1.6 as the target format, including required fields, source systems, asset ownership, quantum-vulnerability status, remediation status, data quality checks, reporting views, and ServiceNow asset correlation.
 Review cryptographic scan outputs, certificate records, certificate chains, cipher suite configurations, Transport Layer Security (TLS) settings, Secure Shell (SSH) settings, Open Authorization (OAuth), Security Assertion Markup Language (SAML), JSON Web Token (JWT) patterns, cloud key records, and key or secret storage evidence under L5 engineer or Principal Architect guidance.
 Support data ingestion, tool integration, and evidence management across Amgen Enterprise systems and cryptographic discovery platforms.
 Assist Digital Identity Access Service (DIAS), Public Key Infrastructure (PKI) service owners, certificate management teams, and identity teams with certificate visibility, certificate ownership, expiration tracking, Certificate Lifecycle Manager (CLM) data needs, manual-to-automated deployment candidates, Certificate Authority (CA) roadmap inputs, and operational change window planning.
 Assist cloud, infrastructure, and platform teams with KMS and secrets inventory, Hardware Security Module (HSM) evidence, key ownership records, key rotation status, key retirement tracking, storage standards, and reporting needed for centralized or federated key management controls.
 Support Application Security, Artificial Intelligence (AI) Security, Enterprise Architecture, Development and Operations (DevOps), and engineering teams with approved cryptographic library adoption, Continuous Integration/Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) scan data, Secure Software Development Life Cycle (SSDLC) requirements, scanning rules, secure code examples, and developer remediation playbooks.
 Track remediation and risk prioritization data for business-critical applications, high-volume sensitive data flows, third-party dependencies, identity services, legacy platforms, Key Computerized Systems (KCS), validated Good x Practice (GxP) systems, and OT scope.
 Support vendor and third-party governance activities with Procurement, Legal, Risk and Compliance, Third Party Risk Management (TPRM), and business owners by collecting technical questionnaire responses, CBOM requests, cryptographic evidence, roadmap updates, and supplier follow-up actions.
 Maintain knowledge articles, implementation guides, training material, exception records, and escalation summaries while monitoring relevant updates from National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST), Internet Engineering Task Force (IETF), National Security Agency Commercial National Security Algorithm Suite 2.0 (NSA CNSA 2.0), International Organization for Standardization (ISO), Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA), Health Information Trust Alliance (HITRUST), and broader industry cryptography guidance.
 Support Artificial Intelligence (AI)-enabled process orchestration activities by documenting manual Encryption Agility Service workflows, identifying repetitive evidence, inventory, reporting, and remediation tracking tasks, testing AI-assisted outputs, and maintaining human-in-the-loop review records for findings, exceptions, and decision-support material under Global Career Framework level 5 (L5) engineer or Principal Architect guidance.
 Basic Qualifications and Experience: 
 Master s degree with 1 to 3 years of experience in Information Security, Cybersecurity, Cryptography, Security Architecture, Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field OR
 Bachelor s degree with 3 to 5 years of experience in Information Security, Cybersecurity, Cryptography, Security Architecture, Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field OR
 Diploma with 7 to 9 years of experience in Information Security, Cybersecurity, Cryptography, Security Architecture, Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field
 Functional Skills: 
 Must-Have Skills: 
 Working knowledge of information security and foundational enterprise cryptography, including PKI, X.509 certificates, TLS, cipher suites, KMS, secrets management, key lifecycle, encryption at rest, encryption in transit, cloud key services, and identity protocols.
 Experience reviewing security tool outputs, maintaining inventory records, validating data quality, documenting findings, updating tickets, and supporting dashboards or operational reports.
 Basic understanding of post-quantum cryptography, crypto agility, cryptographic discovery, CBOM/SBOM concepts, risk-based remediation, and Steal-Now-Decrypt-Later (SNDL) risk.
 Ability to follow technical guidance, document evidence clearly, coordinate with service owners, and escalate complex cryptographic findings or exceptions appropriately.
 Good-to-Have Skills: 
 Experience with ServiceNow Configuration Management Database (CMDB)/Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC), Guard, Wiz, Qualys, Fortinet, Netskope, CrowdStrike, GitLab, Veracode, GitGuardian, Amazon Web Services (AWS) KMS, AWS Certificate Manager, AWS Secrets Manager, Microsoft PKI, Sectigo, HashiCorp Vault, HSMs, Certificate Lifecycle Management (CLM) platforms, or Security Information and Event Management (SIEM)/data lake tools.
 Experience supporting CBOM/SBOM data management using CycloneDX 1.6 , Application Programming Interfaces (APIs), Comma-Separated Values (CSV), JavaScript Object Notation (JSON), spreadsheets, dashboards, data quality checks, and audit-ready reporting.
 Experience supporting certificate lifecycle activities, certificate expiration tracking, certificate ownership updates, certificate rotation evidence, or PKI operational reporting.
 Experience supporting cloud security, application security, DevOps, SSDLC governance, CI/CD quality gates, static analysis, dynamic analysis, composition analysis, or developer remediation tracking.
 Experience in pharmaceutical, life sciences, regulated, validated, GxP, KCS, manufacturing, OT, or other change-controlled environments.
 Experience supporting vendor or third-party risk activities, supplier questionnaires, roadmap tracking, evidence collection, or Software as a Service platform dependency analysis.
 Foundational scripting or data handling experience with Python, PowerShell, Bash, Representational State Transfer Application Programming Interfaces (REST APIs), CSV files, JSON files, or lightweight reporting automation.
 Desired experience using Artificial Intelligence (AI)-enabled tools, workflow automation, or AI agents to support security, governance, risk, compliance, reporting, data quality, or technology operations processes, including the ability to help test outputs, document human review points, and identify opportunities to reduce repetitive manual work.
 Desired familiarity with AI agent concepts, including agent roles, workflow orchestration, tool integration, human-in-the-loop review, output validation, audit trails, and escalation to engineers, architects, or service owners when AI-assisted outputs require technical or risk-based judgment.
 Professional Certifications: 
 Security , Systems Security Certified Practitioner (SSCP), or equivalent foundational security certification (preferred)
 Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP) Associate, CISSP, Certified Information Security Manager (CISM), Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA), or Certified in Risk and Information Systems Control (CRISC) (preferred)
 Certified Cloud Security Professional (CCSP), AWS Certified Security - Specialty, Microsoft Azure Security Engineer, or equivalent cloud security certification (preferred)
 Information Technology Infrastructure Library (ITIL), Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe), product management, or equivalent delivery certification (preferred)
 Relevant PKI, KMS, HSM, cryptographic discovery, certificate lifecycle management, cloud key management, or post-quantum cryptography training/certification (preferred)
 Soft Skills: 
 Excellent analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
 Strong attention to detail and commitment to accurate inventory, evidence, and reporting data.
 Strong verbal and written communication skills for technical and non-technical stakeholders.
 Ability to translate findings into clear documentation, tickets, summaries, and escalation notes.
 Ability to work effectively with global, virtual teams across security, Digital, Technology and Innovation (DTI), DIAS, procurement, legal, compliance, OT, infrastructure, cloud, and application teams.
 High degree of initiative, accountability, and self-motivation while working under technical direction.
 Ability to manage multiple work items, evidence requests, and remediation tracking activities successfully.
 Team oriented, with a focus on shared outcomes, practical execution, and service maturity.
 Comfort learning an emerging technical domain and helping mature a new enterprise capability from the ground up.
 Interest and aptitude for improving human productivity through responsible automation and Artificial Intelligence (AI)-assisted workflows, while maintaining accuracy, documentation quality, and appropriate escalation.
 EQUAL OPPORTUNITY STATEMENT 
 Amgen is an Equal Opportunity employer and will consider you without regard to your race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, or disability status.
 We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided with reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request an accommodation.
 
 
 
.

 High school diploma/GED and 8 years of Information Systems experience
